      "content": "<returncode>0</returncode>\n<output>\n\"\"\"FastAPI surface for the supervised Bambu Lab A1 auto-eject workflow.\n\nThe three endpoints mirror the binding v1 API list and are synchronous: every\nrequest does its work inline and either returns the finished ``.gcode.3mf``\npayload or a validation/slicing error.  There is no printer field, no printer\nconnection, no background job and no acknowledgement step.\n\nBoth ``.gcode.3mf`` readers (this module and :mod:`autoeject.slicer`) are\nexercised against ``fixtures/real_a1.gcode.3mf`` in ``tests/test_app.py``.\n\"\"\"\n\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport io\nimport json\nfrom pathlib import Path\nfrom typing import Any\n\nimport trimesh\nfrom fastapi import FastAPI, File, Form, HTTPException, UploadFile\nfrom fastapi.responses import JSONResponse, Response\nfrom fastapi.staticfiles import StaticFiles\n\nfrom autoeject.ejectability import check\nfrom autoeject.end_block import EjectBlockParams, build_end_block\nfrom autoeject.loop import loop_3mf\nfrom autoeject.sim import (\n    part_bbox_from_gcode,\n    simulate,\n)\nfrom autoeject.slicer import (\n    EXECUTABLE_BLOCK_END,\n    MACHINE_END_START,\n    SliceError,\n    inject_end_block,\n    read_plate_gcode,\n    slice_stl,\n)\n\nSTATIC_DIR = Path(__file__).resolve().parent / \"static\"\nDOWNLOAD_NAME = \"autoeject_a1.gcode.3mf\"\n\napp = FastAPI(\n    title=\"Auto-eject A1\",\n    version=\"1.0\",\n    description=\"Supervised N-copy eject jobs for the Bambu Lab A1 (256 x 256 mm).\",\n)\n\n\n# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n# Helpers\n# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n\n\ndef _is_archive(filename: str | None, content: bytes) -> bool:\n    \"\"\"A ``.gcode.3mf`` is a ZIP archive; sniff the magic first, name second.\"\"\"\n    if content[:4] == b\"PK\\x03\\x04\":\n        return True\n    return (filename or \"\").lower().endswith(\".3mf\")\n\n\ndef _parse_bbox(raw: str | None) -> list[float] | None:\n    if raw is None or not raw.strip():\n        return None\n    try:\n        values = json.loads(raw)\n    except ValueError:\n        values = [item for item in raw.replace(\",\", \" \").split() if item]\n    try:\n        numbers = [float(value) for value in values]\n    except (TypeError, ValueError) as exc:\n        raise ValueError(\"bbox must be six numbers\") from exc\n    if len(numbers) != 6:\n        raise ValueError(\"bbox must be six numbers\")\n    return numbers\n\n\ndef _first_end_block(gcode_text: str) -> str:\n    \"\"\"Return the first eject span, tolerating an N-copy (repeated) archive.\"\"\"\n    start = gcode_text.find(MACHINE_END_START)\n    if start < 0:\n        raise ValueError(f\"expected at least one {MACHINE_END_START!r} marker\")\n    end = gcode_text.find(EXECUTABLE_BLOCK_END, start)\n    if end < 0:\n        raise ValueError(f\"expected {EXECUTABLE_BLOCK_END!r} after the end marker\")\n    return gcode_text[start : end + len(EXECUTABLE_BLOCK_END)]\n\n\ndef _preview(stl_bytes: bytes) -> dict[str, Any]:\n    mesh = trimesh.load(\n        io.BytesIO(stl_bytes), file_type=\"stl\", force=\"mesh\", process=False\n    )\n    bounds = mesh.bounds\n    return {\"bounds\": [float(value) for value in bounds.reshape(-1)]}\n\n\n# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n# Endpoints\n# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n\n\n@app.get(\"/api/health\")\nasync def health() -> dict[str, str]:\n    return {\"status\": \"ok\"}\n\n\n@app.post(\"/api/check\")\nasync def api_check(\n    file: UploadFile = File(...),\n    min_base_area_mm2: float | None = Form(None),\n    max_tip_ratio: float | None = Form(None),\n) -> dict[str, Any]:\n    \"\"\"Measure an STL and return its verdict, reasons and preview box.\"\"\"\n    content = await file.read()\n    if _is_archive(file.filename, content):\n        raise HTTPException(\n            status_code=422,\n            detail=(\n                \"assessment needs an STL; upload the .gcode.3mf to /api/build \"\n                \"and simulate it directly\"\n            ),\n        )\n    try:\n        report = check(\n            content,\n            min_base_area_mm2=min_base_area_mm2,\n            max_tip_ratio=max_tip_ratio,\n        )\n        preview = _preview(content)\n    except ValueError as exc:\n        raise HTTPException(status_code=422, detail=str(exc)) from exc\n    payload = report.to_dict()\n    payload[\"measurements\"] = {\n        rule[\"id\"]: rule[\"measured\"] for rule in payload[\"rules\"]\n    }\n    payload[\"preview\"] = preview\n    return payload\n\n\n@app.post(\"/api/build\")\nasync def _build(\n    file: UploadFile = heat_cool_cycles: int = Form(1),\n    push_feedrate_mm_min: int = Form(600),\n    min_base_area_mm2: float | None = Form(None),\n    max_tip_ratio: float | None = Form(None),\n) -> Response:\n    \"\"\"Slice or patch an A1 job and repeat it N times, then download it.\"\"\"\n    content = await file.read()\n    try:\n        eject_params = EjectBlockParams(\n            cool_bed_temp_c=cool_bed_temp_c,\n            cool_hold_s=cool_hold_s,\n            heat_bed_temp_c=heat_bed_temp_c,\n            heat_hold_s=heat_hold_s,\n            heat_cool_cycles=heat_cool_cycles,\n            push_feedrate_mm_min=push_feedrate_mm_min,\n        )\n        end_block = build_end_block(eject_params)\n    except ValueError as exc:\n        raise HTTPException(status_code=422, detail=str(exc)) from exc\n\n    warnings: list[dict[str, Any]] = []\n    if _is_archive(file.filename, content):\n        try:\n            result = loop_3mf(inject_end_block(content, end_block), n)\n        except (ValueError, SliceError) as exc:\n            raise HTTPException(status_code=422, detail=str(exc)) from exc\n    else:\n        try:\n            report = check(\n                content,\n                min_base_area_mm2=min_base_area_mm2,\n                max_tip_ratio=max_tip_ratio,\n            )\n        except ValueError as exc:\n            raise HTTPException(status_code=422, detail=str(exc)) from exc\n        if report.verdict == \"fail\":\n            # A failing verdict blocks the download synchronously.\n            return JSONResponse(\n                status_code=422,\n                content={\n                    \"error\": \"Part failed the ejectability assessment; build blocked.\",\n                    \"verdict\": report.verdict,\n                    \"reasons\": [\n                        rule.reason\n                        for rule in report.rules\n                        if rule.verdict == \"fail\"\n                    ],\n                    \"rules\": [rule.to_dict() for rule in report.rules],\n                },\n            )\n        warnings = [\n            rule.to_dict() for rule in report.rules if rule.verdict == \"warn\"\n        ]\n        try:\n            sliced = slice_stl(content, end_block)\n            result = loop_3mf(sliced, n)\n        except (ValueError, SliceError) as exc:\n            raise HTTPException(status_code=422, detail=str(exc)) from exc\n\n    headers = {\n        \"Content-Disposition\": f'attachment; Form(None),\n) -> dict[str, Any]:\n    \"\"\"Replay eject moves from a plate G-code, end block or archive.\"\"\"\n    content = await file.read()\n    try:\n        supplied = _parse_bbox(bbox)\n part_bbox_from_gcode(gcode)\n        else:\n            try:\n                text = content.decode(\"utf-8\")\n            except UnicodeDecodeError as exc:\n                raise ValueError(\"G-code must be UTF-8 text\") from exc\n            block = (\n                _first_end_block(text)\n                if MACHINE_END_START in text\n                else text\n            )\n            if supplied is None:\n                raise ValueError(\n                    \"a bounding box is required when simulating a bare end block\"\n                )\n            part = supplied\n        report = simulate(block, part)\n    except ValueError as exc:\n        raise HTTPException(status_code=422, detail=str(exc)) from exc\n    return report.to_dict()\n\n\n# The static single page is       "extra": {
        "raw_output": "\"\"\"FastAPI surface for the supervised Bambu Lab A1 auto-eject workflow.\n\nThe three endpoints mirror the binding v1 API list and are synchronous: every\nrequest does its work inline and either returns the finished ``.gcode.3mf``\npayload or a validation/slicing error.  There is no printer field, no printer\nconnection, no background job and no acknowledgement step.\n\nBoth ``.gcode.3mf`` readers (this module and :mod:`autoeject.slicer`) are\nexercised against ``fixtures/real_a1.gcode.3mf`` in ``tests/test_app.py``.\n\"\"\"\n\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport io\nimport json\nfrom pathlib import Path\nfrom typing import Any\n\nimport trimesh\nfrom fastapi import FastAPI, File, Form, HTTPException, UploadFile\nfrom fastapi.responses import JSONResponse, Response\nfrom fastapi.staticfiles import StaticFiles\n\nfrom autoeject.ejectability import check\nfrom autoeject.end_block import EjectBlockParams, build_end_block\nfrom autoeject.loop import loop_3mf\nfrom autoeject.sim import (\n    part_bbox_from_gcode,\n    simulate,\n)\nfrom autoeject.slicer import (\n    EXECUTABLE_BLOCK_END,\n    MACHINE_END_START,\n    SliceError,\n    inject_end_block,\n    read_plate_gcode,\n    slice_stl,\n)\n\nSTATIC_DIR = Path(__file__).resolve().parent / \"static\"\nDOWNLOAD_NAME = \"autoeject_a1.gcode.3mf\"\n\napp = FastAPI(\n    title=\"Auto-eject A1\",\n    version=\"1.0\",\n    description=\"Supervised N-copy eject jobs for the Bambu Lab A1 (256 x 256 mm).\",\n)\n\n\n# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n# Helpers\n# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n\n\ndef _is_archive(filename: str | None, content: bytes) -> bool:\n    \"\"\"A ``.gcode.3mf`` is a ZIP archive; sniff the magic first, name second.\"\"\"\n    if content[:4] == b\"PK\\x03\\x04\":\n        return True\n    return (filename or \"\").lower().endswith(\".3mf\")\n\n\ndef _parse_bbox(raw: str | None) -> list[float] | None:\n    if raw is None or not raw.strip():\n        return None\n    try:\n        values = json.loads(raw)\n    except ValueError:\n        values = [item for item in raw.replace(\",\", \" \").split() if item]\n    try:\n        numbers = [float(value) for value in values]\n    except (TypeError, ValueError) as exc:\n        raise ValueError(\"bbox must be six numbers\") from exc\n    if len(numbers) != 6:\n        raise ValueError(\"bbox must be six numbers\")\n    return numbers\n\n\ndef _first_end_block(gcode_text: str) -> str:\n    \"\"\"Return the first eject span, tolerating an N-copy (repeated) archive.\"\"\"\n    start = gcode_text.find(MACHINE_END_START)\n    if start < 0:\n        raise ValueError(f\"expected at least one {MACHINE_END_START!r} marker\")\n    end = gcode_text.find(EXECUTABLE_BLOCK_END, start)\n    if end < 0:\n        raise ValueError(f\"expected {EXECUTABLE_BLOCK_END!r} after the end marker\")\n    return gcode_text[start : end + len(EXECUTABLE_BLOCK_END)]\n\n\ndef _preview(stl_bytes: bytes) -> dict[str, Any]:\n    mesh = trimesh.load(\n        io.BytesIO(stl_bytes), file_type=\"stl\", force=\"mesh\", process=False\n    )\n    bounds = mesh.bounds\n    return {\"bounds\": [float(value) for value in bounds.reshape(-1)]}\n\n\n# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n# Endpoints\n# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n\n\n@app.get(\"/api/health\")\nasync def health() -> dict[str, str]:\n    return {\"status\": \"ok\"}\n\n\n@app.post(\"/api/check\")\nasync def api_check(\n    file: UploadFile = File(...),\n    min_base_area_mm2: float | None = Form(None),\n    max_tip_ratio: float | None = Form(None),\n) -> dict[str, Any]:\n    \"\"\"Measure an STL and return its verdict, reasons and preview box.\"\"\"\n    content = await file.read()\n    if _is_archive(file.filename, content):\n        raise HTTPException(\n            status_code=422,\n            detail=(\n                \"assessment needs an STL; upload the .gcode.3mf to /api/build \"\n                \"and simulate it directly\"\n            ),\n        )\n    try:\n        report = check(\n            content,\n            min_base_area_mm2=min_base_area_mm2,\n            max_tip_ratio=max_tip_ratio,\n        )\n        preview = _preview(content)\n    except ValueError as exc:\n        raise HTTPException(status_code=422, detail=str(exc)) from exc\n    payload = report.to_dict()\n    payload[\"measurements\"] = {\n        rule[\"id\"]: rule[\"measured\"] for rule in payload[\"rules\"]\n    }\n    payload[\"preview\"] = preview\n    return payload\n\n\n@app.post(\"/api/build\")\nasync def _build(\n    file: UploadFile = File(...),\n    n: int = Form(1),\n    cool_bed_temp_c: int = Form(25),\n    cool_hold_s: int = Form(120),\n    heat_bed_temp_c: int = Form(60),\n    heat_hold_s: int = Form(60),\n    heat_cool_cycles: int = Form(1),\n    push_feedrate_mm_min: int = Form(600),\n    min_base_area_mm2: float | None = Form(None),\n    max_tip_ratio: float | None = Form(None),\n) -> Response:\n    \"\"\"Slice or patch an A1 job and repeat it N times, then download it.\"\"\"\n    content = await file.read()\n    try:\n        eject_params = EjectBlockParams(\n            cool_bed_temp_c=cool_bed_temp_c,\n            cool_hold_s=cool_hold_s,\n            heat_bed_temp_c=heat_bed_temp_c,\n            heat_hold_s=heat_hold_s,\n            heat_cool_cycles=heat_cool_cycles,\n            push_feedrate_mm_min=push_feedrate_mm_min,\n        )\n        end_block = build_end_block(eject_params)\n    except ValueError as exc:\n        raise HTTPException(status_code=422, detail=str(exc)) from exc\n\n    warnings: list[dict[str, Any]] = []\n    if _is_archive(file.filename, content):\n        try:\n            result = loop_3mf(inject_end_block(content, end_block), n)\n        except (ValueError, SliceError) as exc:\n            raise HTTPException(status_code=422, detail=str(exc)) from exc\n    else:\n        try:\n            report = check(\n                content,\n                min_base_area_mm2=min_base_area_mm2,\n                max_tip_ratio=max_tip_ratio,\n            )\n        except ValueError as exc:\n            raise HTTPException(status_code=422, detail=str(exc)) from exc\n        if report.verdict == \"fail\":\n            # A failing verdict blocks the download synchronously.\n            return JSONResponse(\n                status_code=422,\n                content={\n                    \"error\": \"Part failed the ejectability assessment; build blocked.\",\n                    \"verdict\": report.verdict,\n                    \"reasons\": [\n                        rule.reason\n                        for rule in report.rules\n                        if rule.verdict == \"fail\"\n                    ],\n                    \"rules\": [rule.to_dict() for rule in report.rules],\n                },\n            )\n        warnings = [\n            rule.to_dict() for rule in report.rules if rule.verdict == \"warn\"\n        ]\n        try:\n            sliced = slice_stl(content, end_block)\n            result = loop_3mf(sliced, n)\n        except (ValueError, SliceError) as exc:\n            raise HTTPException(status_code=422, detail=str(exc)) from exc\n\n    headers = {\n        \"Content-Disposition\": f'attachment; filename=\"{DOWNLOAD_NAME}\"',\n        \"X-Eject-Verdict\": \"warn\" if warnings else \"pass\",\n    }\n    return Response(\n        content=result,\n        media_type=\"application/octet-stream\",\n        headers=headers,\n    )\n\n\n@app.post(\"/api/simulate\")\nasync def api_simulate(\n    file: UploadFile = File(...),\n    bbox: str | None = Form(None),\n) -> dict[str, Any]:\n    \"\"\"Replay eject moves from a plate G-code, end block or archive.\"\"\"\n    content = await file.read()\n    try:\n        supplied = _parse_bbox(bbox)\n        if _is_archive(file.filename, content):\n            gcode = read_plate_gcode(content)\n            block = _first_end_block(gcode)\n            part = supplied if supplied is not None else part_bbox_from_gcode(gcode)\n        else:\n            try:\n                text = content.decode(\"utf-8\")\n            except UnicodeDecodeError as exc:\n                raise ValueError(\"G-code must be UTF-8 text\") from exc\n            block = (\n                _first_end_block(text)\n                if MACHINE_END_START in text\n                else text\n            )\n            if supplied is None:\n                raise ValueError(\n                    \"a bounding box is required when simulating a bare end block\"\n                )\n            part = supplied\n        report = simulate(block, part)\n    except ValueError as exc:\n        raise HTTPException(status_code=422, detail=str(exc)) from exc\n    return report.to_dict()\n\n\n# The static single page is mounted last so the API routes win.\napp.mount(\"/\", StaticFiles(directory=STATIC_DIR, html=True), name=\"static\")\n",

  "changes": {
    "Dockerfile": "# Auto-eject A1 web app image -- NOT built in CI.\n#\n# Building this image downloads a pinned BambuStudio CLI and is therefore kept\n# out of automated test runs.  The CLI stage below is commented on purpose so a\n# plain `docker build` cannot silently pull an unpinned slicer.\n#\n# To build locally: uncomment the BambuStudio block, verify the checksum/URL in\n# the binding environment, then run `docker build -t autoeject .`.\n\nFROM python:3.13-slim AS runtime\n\nENV PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 \\\n    PYTHONUNBUFFERED=1 \\\n    UV_LINK_MODE=copy \\\n    UV_PROJECT_ENVIRONMENT=/opt/venv \\\n    PATH=\"/opt/venv/bin:${PATH}\"\n\n# uv, pinned by digest so the runtime dependency resolution is reproducible.\nCOPY --from=ghcr.io/astral-sh/uv:0.5.11 /uv /uvx /bin/\n\nWORKDIR /app\n\nCOPY pyproject.toml uv.lock ./\nRUN uv sync --frozen --no-dev\n\nCOPY autoeject ./autoeject\nCOPY app ./app\nCOPY profiles ./profiles\n\n# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n# Pinned BambuStudio CLI (not run in CI).\n#\n# BambuStudio ships an AppImage; extract it into /opt/bambustudio and expose\n# the CLI.  Pin the exact release used for the seed fixture and verify the\n# checksum before use.\n#\n# ARG BAMBU_STUDIO_VERSION=02.04.00.70\n# ARG BAMBU_STUDIO_URL=https://github.com/bambulab/BambuStudio/releases/download/v${BAMBU_STUDIO_VERSION}/Bambu_Studio_linux_ubuntu-v${BAMBU_STUDIO_VERSION}.AppImage\n# RUN apt-get update \\\n#     && apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends fuse libgl1 libglib2.0-0 \\\n#     && rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/* \\\n#     && curl -fsSL \"${BAMBU_STUDIO_URL}\" -o /opt/BambuStudio.AppImage \\\n#     && chmod +x /opt/BambuStudio.AppImage \\\n#     && /opt/BambuStudio.AppImage --appimage-extract \\\n#     && mv squashfs-root /opt/bambustudio\nENV BAMBU_CLI=/opt/bambustudio/AppRun \\\n    BAMBU_PROFILE_ROOT=/opt/bambustudio/resources/profiles/BBL\n# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n\nEXPOSE 8000\n\n# The FastAPI app serves the static UI and the /api/check, /api/build and\n# /api/simulate endpoints.\nCMD [\"uvicorn\", \"app.main:app\", \"--host\", \"0.0.0.0\", \"--port\", \"8000\"]\n",
    "README.md": "# Auto-eject A1\n\nA web app for the **Bambu Lab A1 only** (256 \u00d7 256 mm bed). It turns one part into\na supervised loop of *N* prints, pushing each finished part off the bed with the\nFactorian Designs end block.\n\nThe Python core lives in `autoeject/` (no web imports); the FastAPI app and static\nUI live in `app/`; tests live in `tests/`.\n\n## Endpoints\n\n| Method | Path | Purpose |\n| --- | --- | --- |\n| POST | `/api/check` | Measure an STL and return pass/warn/fail with reasons. |\n| POST | `/api/build` | Slice an STL (or patch a sliced `.gcode.3mf`) and return an N-copy `.gcode.3mf`. |\n| POST | `/api/simulate` | Replay the eject moves and report pushes, collisions and misses. |\n\nMultipart uploads use the field name `file`; the iteration count is the form\nfield `n`. Everything is synchronous and A1-only. A failing verdict blocks the\ndownload; a warning is shown but does not block.\n\n> **Supervised use only.** The heat/cool cycle does not prove that the part has\n> released. Inspect the bed and the exit path between copies; do not run the loop\n> unattended.\n\n## Run locally\n\nRequires Python 3.13 and [uv](https://docs.astral.sh/uv/).\n\n```bash\nuv sync\nuv run uvicorn app.main:app --reload --port 8000\n```\n\nOpen <http://127.0.0.1:8000/> and upload an STL, or a pre-sliced `.gcode.3mf`.\nRun the tests with:\n\n```bash\nuv run pytest -q\n```\n\nTo slice in-process, point the app at a BambuStudio CLI and its installed A1\nprofiles:\n\n```bash\nexport BAMBU_CLI=/path/to/bambustudio/AppRun\nexport BAMBU_PROFILE_ROOT=/path/to/bambustudio/resources/profiles/BBL\n```\n\nWithout `BAMBU_CLI` the STL path returns a synchronous error and directs you to\nthe pre-sliced fallback.\n\n### Export a sliced plate from Bambu Studio\n\n1. Open the part in Bambu Studio, select the **Bambu Lab A1** printer and a\n   process/filament profile, and slice it.\n2. Use **File \u2192 Export \u2192 Export plate sliced file** (or the plate context menu\n   **Export plate sliced file\u2026**) and save the `.gcode.3mf`.\n3. Upload that file to the app. Only the stock end block, between\n   `; MACHINE_END_GCODE_START` and `; EXECUTABLE_BLOCK_END`, is replaced; the\n   `Metadata/plate_1.gcode.md5` companion is recomputed.\n\n## Deploy\n\n`railway.toml` builds the `Dockerfile` and starts\n`uvicorn app.main:app --host 0.0.0.0 --port $PORT`. The Dockerfile leaves the\nBambuStudio CLI install block commented out, so a plain image build does not\nsilently download an unpinned slicer.\n",
    "app/__init__.py": "\"\"\"FastAPI web app and static UI for the supervised A1 auto-eject workflow.\"\"\"\n",
    "app/main.py": "\"\"\"FastAPI surface for the supervised Bambu Lab A1 auto-eject workflow.\n\nThe three endpoints mirror the binding v1 API list and are synchronous: every\nrequest does its work inline and either returns the finished ``.gcode.3mf``\npayload or a validation/slicing error.  There is no printer field, no printer\nconnection, no background job and no acknowledgement step.\n\nBoth ``.gcode.3mf`` readers (this module and :mod:`autoeject.slicer`) are\nexercised against ``fixtures/real_a1.gcode.3mf`` in ``tests/test_app.py``.\n\"\"\"\n\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport io\nimport json\nfrom pathlib import Path\nfrom typing import Any\n\nimport trimesh\nfrom fastapi import FastAPI, File, Form, HTTPException, UploadFile\nfrom fastapi.responses import JSONResponse, Response\nfrom fastapi.staticfiles import StaticFiles\n\nfrom autoeject.ejectability import check\nfrom autoeject.end_block import EjectBlockParams, build_end_block\nfrom autoeject.loop import loop_3mf\nfrom autoeject.sim import (\n    part_bbox_from_gcode,\n    simulate,\n)\nfrom autoeject.slicer import (\n    EXECUTABLE_BLOCK_END,\n    MACHINE_END_START,\n    SliceError,\n    inject_end_block,\n    read_plate_gcode,\n    slice_stl,\n)\n\nSTATIC_DIR = Path(__file__).resolve().parent / \"static\"\nDOWNLOAD_NAME = \"autoeject_a1.gcode.3mf\"\n\napp = FastAPI(\n    title=\"Auto-eject A1\",\n    version=\"1.0\",\n    description=\"Supervised N-copy eject jobs for the Bambu Lab A1 (256 x 256 mm).\",\n)\n\n\n# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n# Helpers\n# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n\n\ndef _is_archive(filename: str | None, content: bytes) -> bool:\n    \"\"\"A ``.gcode.3mf`` is a ZIP archive; sniff the magic first, name second.\"\"\"\n    if content[:4] == b\"PK\\x03\\x04\":\n        return True\n    return (filename or \"\").lower().endswith(\".3mf\")\n\n\ndef _parse_bbox(raw: str | None) -> list[float] | None:\n    if raw is None or not raw.strip():\n        return None\n    try:\n        values = json.loads(raw)\n    except ValueError:\n        values = [item for item in raw.replace(\",\", \" \").split() if item]\n    try:\n        numbers = [float(value) for value in values]\n    except (TypeError, ValueError) as exc:\n        raise ValueError(\"bbox must be six numbers\") from exc\n    if len(numbers) != 6:\n        raise ValueError(\"bbox must be six numbers\")\n    return numbers\n\n\ndef _first_end_block(gcode_text: str) -> str:\n    \"\"\"Return the first eject span, tolerating an N-copy (repeated) archive.\"\"\"\n    start = gcode_text.find(MACHINE_END_START)\n    if start < 0:\n        raise ValueError(f\"expected at least one {MACHINE_END_START!r} marker\")\n    end = gcode_text.find(EXECUTABLE_BLOCK_END, start)\n    if end < 0:\n        raise ValueError(f\"expected {EXECUTABLE_BLOCK_END!r} after the end marker\")\n    return gcode_text[start : end + len(EXECUTABLE_BLOCK_END)]\n\n\ndef _preview(stl_bytes: bytes) -> dict[str, Any]:\n    mesh = trimesh.load(\n        io.BytesIO(stl_bytes), file_type=\"stl\", force=\"mesh\", process=False\n    )\n    bounds = mesh.bounds\n    return {\"bounds\": [float(value) for value in bounds.reshape(-1)]}\n\n\n# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n# Endpoints\n# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n\n\n@app.get(\"/api/health\")\nasync def health() -> dict[str, str]:\n    return {\"status\": \"ok\"}\n\n\n@app.post(\"/api/check\")\nasync def api_check(\n    file: UploadFile = File(...),\n    min_base_area_mm2: float | None = Form(None),\n    max_tip_ratio: float | None = Form(None),\n) -> dict[str, Any]:\n    \"\"\"Measure an STL and return its verdict, reasons and preview box.\"\"\"\n    content = await file.read()\n    if _is_archive(file.filename, content):\n        raise HTTPException(\n            status_code=422,\n            detail=(\n                \"assessment needs an STL; upload the .gcode.3mf to /api/build \"\n                \"and simulate it directly\"\n            ),\n        )\n    try:\n        report = check(\n            content,\n            min_base_area_mm2=min_base_area_mm2,\n            max_tip_ratio=max_tip_ratio,\n        )\n        preview = _preview(content)\n    except ValueError as exc:\n        raise HTTPException(status_code=422, detail=str(exc)) from exc\n    payload = report.to_dict()\n    payload[\"measurements\"] = {\n        rule[\"id\"]: rule[\"measured\"] for rule in payload[\"rules\"]\n    }\n    payload[\"preview\"] = preview\n    return payload\n\n\n@app.post(\"/api/build\")\nasync def _build(\n    file: UploadFile = File(...),\n    n: int = Form(1),\n    cool_bed_temp_c: int = Form(25),\n    cool_hold_s: int = Form(120),\n    heat_bed_temp_c: int = Form(60),\n    heat_hold_s: int = Form(60),\n    heat_cool_cycles: int = Form(1),\n    push_feedrate_mm_min: int = Form(600),\n    min_base_area_mm2: float | None = Form(None),\n    max_tip_ratio: float | None = Form(None),\n) -> Response:\n    \"\"\"Slice or patch an A1 job and repeat it N times, then download it.\"\"\"\n    content = await file.read()\n    try:\n        eject_params = EjectBlockParams(\n            cool_bed_temp_c=cool_bed_temp_c,\n            cool_hold_s=cool_hold_s,\n            heat_bed_temp_c=heat_bed_temp_c,\n            heat_hold_s=heat_hold_s,\n            heat_cool_cycles=heat_cool_cycles,\n            push_feedrate_mm_min=push_feedrate_mm_min,\n        )\n        end_block = build_end_block(eject_params)\n    except ValueError as exc:\n        raise HTTPException(status_code=422, detail=str(exc)) from exc\n\n    warnings: list[dict[str, Any]] = []\n    if _is_archive(file.filename, content):\n        try:\n            result = loop_3mf(inject_end_block(content, end_block), n)\n        except (ValueError, SliceError) as exc:\n            raise HTTPException(status_code=422, detail=str(exc)) from exc\n    else:\n        try:\n            report = check(\n                content,\n                min_base_area_mm2=min_base_area_mm2,\n                max_tip_ratio=max_tip_ratio,\n            )\n        except ValueError as exc:\n            raise HTTPException(status_code=422, detail=str(exc)) from exc\n        if report.verdict == \"fail\":\n            # A failing verdict blocks the download synchronously.\n            return JSONResponse(\n                status_code=422,\n                content={\n                    \"error\": \"Part failed the ejectability assessment; build blocked.\",\n                    \"verdict\": report.verdict,\n                    \"reasons\": [\n                        rule.reason\n                        for rule in report.rules\n                        if rule.verdict == \"fail\"\n                    ],\n                    \"rules\": [rule.to_dict() for rule in report.rules],\n                },\n            )\n        warnings = [\n            rule.to_dict() for rule in report.rules if rule.verdict == \"warn\"\n        ]\n        try:\n            sliced = slice_stl(content, end_block)\n            result = loop_3mf(sliced, n)\n        except (ValueError, SliceError) as exc:\n            raise HTTPException(status_code=422, detail=str(exc)) from exc\n\n    headers = {\n        \"Content-Disposition\": f'attachment; filename=\"{DOWNLOAD_NAME}\"',\n        \"X-Eject-Verdict\": \"warn\" if warnings else \"pass\",\n    }\n    return Response(\n        content=result,\n        media_type=\"application/octet-stream\",\n        headers=headers,\n    )\n\n\n@app.post(\"/api/simulate\")\nasync def api_simulate(\n    file: UploadFile = File(...),\n    bbox: str | None = Form(None),\n) -> dict[str, Any]:\n    \"\"\"Replay eject moves from a plate G-code, end block or archive.\"\"\"\n    content = await file.read()\n    try:\n        supplied = _parse_bbox(bbox)\n        if _is_archive(file.filename, content):\n            gcode = read_plate_gcode(content)\n            block = _first_end_block(gcode)\n            part = supplied if supplied is not None else part_bbox_from_gcode(gcode)\n        else:\n            try:\n                text = content.decode(\"utf-8\")\n            except UnicodeDecodeError as exc:\n                raise ValueError(\"G-code must be UTF-8 text\") from exc\n            block = (\n                _first_end_block(text)\n                if MACHINE_END_START in text\n                else text\n            )\n            if supplied is None:\n                raise ValueError(\n                    \"a bounding box is required when simulating a bare end block\"\n                )\n            part = supplied\n        report = simulate(block, part)\n    except ValueError as exc:\n        raise HTTPException(status_code=422, detail=str(exc)) from exc\n    return report.to_dict()\n\n\n# The static single page is mounted last so the API routes win.\napp.mount(\"/\", StaticFiles(directory=STATIC_DIR, html=True), name=\"static\")\n",
    "app/static/index.html": "<!DOCTYPE html>\n<html lang=\"en\">\n<head>\n<meta charset=\"utf-8\" />\n<meta name=\"viewport\" content=\"width=device-width, initial-scale=1\" />\n<title>Auto-eject A1</title>\n<style>\n  :root { color-scheme: dark; }\n  * { box-sizing: border-box; }\n  body {\n    margin: 0; font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, Segoe UI, Roboto, sans-serif;\n    background: #12151b; color: #e6e9ef;\n  }\n  header { padding: 14px 20px; border-bottom: 1px solid #262b36; }\n  header h1 { margin: 0; font-size: 18px; }\n  header p { margin: 4px 0 0; color: #9aa4b2; font-size: 13px; }\n  main { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 360px 1fr; gap: 16px; padding: 16px; }\n  @media (max-width: 900px) { main { grid-template-columns: 1fr; } }\n  .panel { background: #1a1e27; border: 1px solid #262b36; border-radius: 8px; padding: 14px; }\n  label { display: block; font-size: 12px; color: #9aa4b2; margin: 10px 0 4px; }\n  input, select { width: 100%; padding: 7px 9px; background: #0f1218; color: #e6e9ef;\n    border: 1px solid #333a48; border-radius: 5px; font-size: 13px; }\n  .row { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; gap: 10px; }\n  button { margin-top: 12px; width: 100%; padding: 10px; border: 0; border-radius: 6px;\n    font-size: 14px; font-weight: 600; cursor: pointer; }\n  #checkBtn { background: #2c3e63; color: #dfe8ff; }\n  #buildBtn { background: #1f7a4d; color: #eafff3; }\n  #downloadBtn { background: #6b4bd6; color: #f3efff; display: none; }\n  button:disabled { opacity: .45; cursor: not-allowed; }\n  #verdict { margin-top: 12px; padding: 10px; border-radius: 6px; font-weight: 700;\n    text-align: center; background: #232936; }\n  #verdict.pass { background: #14532d; }\n  #verdict.warn { background: #6b5200; }\n  #verdict.fail { background: #7f1d1d; }\n  #reasons { list-style: none; padding: 0; margin: 10px 0 0; font-size: 12px; }\n  #reasons li { padding: 6px 8px; margin-bottom: 5px; border-radius: 5px;\n    background: #0f1218; border-left: 3px solid #444; }\n  #reasons li.fail { border-color: #ef4444; }\n  #reasons li.warn { border-color: #eab308; }\n  #reasons li.pass { border-color: #22c55e; }\n  .note { font-size: 11px; color: #9aa4b2; margin-top: 10px; line-height: 1.5; }\n  #error { color: #fca5a5; font-size: 12px; margin-top: 10px; white-space: pre-wrap; }\n  #viewport { position: relative; min-height: 560px; }\n  #viewport canvas { width: 100%; height: 100%; display: block; border-radius: 8px; }\n  #simStatus { position: absolute; top: 10px; left: 12px; font-size: 12px; color: #cbd5e1;\n    background: rgba(15,18,24,.7); padding: 6px 9px; border-radius: 6px; }\n</style>\n</head>\n<body>\n<header>\n  <h1>Auto-eject A1 \u2014 supervised N-copy loop</h1>\n  <p>Bambu Lab A1 only (256 \u00d7 256 mm bed). This is a supervised workflow: cooling does not\n     guarantee release. Inspect the bed and exit path between copies.</p>\n</header>\n<main>\n  <section class=\"panel\">\n    <label for=\"file\">STL or sliced A1 .gcode.3mf</label>\n    <input id=\"file\" type=\"file\" accept=\".stl,.3mf,.gcode.3mf\" />\n\n    <div class=\"row\">\n      <div>\n        <label for=\"n\">Copies N (1\u2013100)</label>\n        <input id=\"n\" type=\"number\" min=\"1\" max=\"100\" value=\"3\" />\n      </div>\n      <div>\n        <label for=\"push\">Push feedrate (mm/min)</label>\n        <input id=\"push\" type=\"number\" min=\"1\" max=\"18000\" value=\"600\" />\n      </div>\n    </div>\n\n    <div class=\"row\">\n      <div>\n        <label for=\"coolTemp\">Cool bed temp (\u00b0C)</label>\n        <input id=\"coolTemp\" type=\"number\" min=\"0\" max=\"120\" value=\"25\" />\n      </div>\n      <div>\n        <label for=\"coolHold\">Cool hold (s)</label>\n        <input id=\"coolHold\" type=\"number\" min=\"0\" max=\"3600\" value=\"120\" />\n      </div>\n    </div>\n    <div class=\"row\">\n      <div>\n        <label for=\"heatTemp\">Heat bed temp (\u00b0C)</label>\n        <input id=\"heatTemp\" type=\"number\" min=\"0\" max=\"120\" value=\"60\" />\n      </div>\n      <div>\n        <label for=\"heatHold\">Heat hold (s)</label>\n        <input id=\"heatHold\" type=\"number\" min=\"0\" max=\"3600\" value=\"60\" />\n      </div>\n    </div>\n    <label for=\"cycles\">Heat/cool cycles (1\u2013100)</label>\n    <input id=\"cycles\" type=\"number\" min=\"1\" max=\"100\" value=\"1\" />\n\n    <button id=\"checkBtn\" type=\"button\">Check part</button>\n    <button id=\"buildBtn\" type=\"button\">Build &amp; download job</button>\n    <button id=\"downloadBtn\" type=\"button\">Download .gcode.3mf</button>\n    <div id=\"verdict\">No part checked</div>\n    <ul id=\"reasons\"></ul>\n    <div id=\"error\"></div>\n    <p class=\"note\">The generated end sequence runs the configured complete cool-and-heat\n      cycles before the push. Part release is not guaranteed; keep the process supervised\n      and never operate the loop unattended.</p>\n  </section>\n\n  <section class=\"panel\" id=\"viewport\">\n    <div id=\"simStatus\">Preview \u2014 drag to rotate, scroll to zoom</div>\n  </section>\n</main>\n\n<script src=\"https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/three.js/r128/three.min.js\"></script>\n<script>\n(() => {\n  \"use strict\";\n  const $ = (id) => document.getElementById(id);\n  const PLATE = 256;\n\n  // ---------------------------------------------------------------- three.js\n  const viewport = $(\"viewport\");\n  const scene = new THREE.Scene();\n  scene.background = new THREE.Color(0x0f1218);\n  const camera = new THREE.PerspectiveCamera(45, 1, 1, 4000);\n  camera.position.set(0, 260, 340);\n  camera.lookAt(0, 40, 0);\n  const renderer = new THREE.WebGLRenderer({ antialias: true });\n  viewport.appendChild(renderer.domElement);\n  renderer.setPixelRatio(Math.min(window.devicePixelRatio, 2));\n\n  scene.add(new THREE.AmbientLight(0xffffff, 0.7));\n  const key = new clearGroup(partGroup);\n    if (!bounds || bounds.length !== 6) return;\n    const [x0, y0, z0, x1, y1, z1] = bounds;\n    const mesh = new THREE.Mesh(\n      new THREE.BoxGeometry(x1 - x0, z1 - z0, partGroup.add(mesh);\n  }\n\n  // Minimal binary/ASCII STL parser so the part needs no external CAD model.\n  function parseSTL(buffer) {\n    const probe = new TextDecoder().decode(new positions;\n  }\n\n  function renderPartSTL(buffer) {\n    clearGroup(partGroup);\n    const source = parseSTL(buffer);\n    if (!source.length) return;\n    // Plate (x, y, z) -> three (x, z, y).\n let simIndex = 0;\n  let simTimer = null;\n  let currentBBox = null;\n\n  function applyMove(move) {\n    toolhead.position.set(move.x, move.z + 20, move.y);\n    gantry.position.set(PLATE / 2, move.z 0;\n    if (simMoves.length) {\n      applyMove(simMoves[0]);\n      $(\"simStatus\").textContent = \"Eject simulation \u2014 \" + simMoves.length + \" replayed moves\";\n    }\n    if (simTimer) clearInterval(simTimer);\n    simTimer = setInterval(animateSim, 60);\n    render();\n  }\n\n  function render() {\n    renderer.render(scene, camera);\n  }\n\n  // Drag to rotate, wheel to zoom \u2014 no external controls script required.\n  let dragging = false, px = 0, py = 0;\n  renderer.domElement.addEventListener(\"pointerdown\", (e) => {\n    dragging = true; px = e.clientX; py = e.clientY;\n  });\n  window.addEventListener(\"pointerup\", () => { dragging = false; });\n  window.addEventListener(\"pointermove\", (e) => {\n    if (!dragging) return;\n    world.rotation.y += (e.clientX - px) * 0.008;\n    world.rotation.x += (e.clientY - py) * 0.006;\n    world.rotation.x = Math.max(-1.4, Math.min(0.2, world.rotation.x));\n    px = e.clientX; py = e.clientY; render();\n  });\n  renderer.domElement.addEventListener(\"wheel\", (e) => {\n    e.preventDefault();\n    camera.position.multiplyScalar(e.deltaY > 0 ? 1.1 : 0.9);\n    render();\n  }, { passive: false });\n\n heat_hold_s: $(\"heatHold\").value,\n      heat_cool_cycles: $(\"cycles\").value,\n      push_feedrate_mm_min: $(\"push\").value,\n    };\n  }\n\n  function showVerdict(verdict, rules) {\n    const $(\"downloadBtn\").style.display = \"block\";\n  }\n\n  $(\"downloadBtn\").addEventListener(\"click\", () => {\n    if (!downloadUrl) return;\n    const link = document.createElement(\"a\");\n $(\"downloadBtn\").style.display = \"none\";\n    const file = $(\"file\").files[0];\n    if (!file) return;\n    if (/\\.stl$/i.test(file.name)) {\n      renderPartSTL(await file.arrayBuffer());\n      render();\n    }\n  });\n\n  $(\"checkBtn\").addEventListener(\"click\", async () => {\n    showError(\"\");\n    const file = $(\"file\").files[0];\n    if (!file) { showError(\"Choose an STL response.json().catch(() => ({}));\n    if (!response.ok) {\n      showError(data.detail || \"Assessment failed.\");\n      showVerdict(\"fail\", []);\n      return;\n    }\n    showVerdict(data.verdict, data.rules);\n    if (data.preview && data.preview.bounds) {\n      renderPartBox(data.preview.bounds);\n      render();\n    }\n  });\n\n  $(\"buildBtn\").addEventListener(\"click\", async () => {\n    showError(\"\");\n    const file = $(\"file\").files[0];\n    if (!file) { showError(\"Choose an STL or a sliced .gcode.3mf first.\");     "autoeject/ejectability.py": "\"\"\"Deterministic STL ejectability checks for the 256 x 256 mm A1 bed.\"\"\"\n\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport math\nfrom dataclasses import asdict, dataclass\nfrom io import BytesIO\nfrom typing import Any\n\nimport numpy as np\nimport trimesh\nfrom shapely.geometry import Polygon\nfrom shapely.ops import unary_union\n\nBED_WIDTH_MM = 256.0\nBED_DEPTH_MM = 256.0\nNOZZLE_PUSH_HEIGHT_MM = 32.0\nGANTRY_PUSH_MIN_LAYER_Z_MM = 41.0\nMIN_BASE_AREA_MM2 = 100.0\nMAX_TIP_RATIO = 2.0\n\n\n@dataclass(frozen=True)\nclass Rule:\n    id: str\n    measured: float | bool\n    threshold: str\n    verdict: str\n    reason: str\n\n    def to_dict(self) -> dict[str, Any]:\n        return asdict(self)\n\n\n@dataclass(frozen=True)\nclass Report:\n    verdict: str\n    rules: tuple[Rule, ...]\n\n    def to_dict(self) -> dict[str, Any]:\n        return {\n            \"verdict\": self.verdict,\n            \"rules\": [rule.to_dict() for rule in self.rules],\n        }\n\n\ndef _base_footprint(mesh: trimesh.Trimesh) -> Polygon | Any:\n    \"\"\"Return the union of triangles touching the lowest plane of the mesh.\"\"\"\n    z_min = float(mesh.bounds[0, 2])\n    triangles = mesh.triangles\n    on_base = np.all(np.isclose(triangles[:, :, 2], z_min, atol=1e-7), axis=1)\n    polygons = []\n    for triangle in triangles[on_base, :, :2]:\n        polygon = Polygon(triangle)\n        if not polygon.is_valid:\n            polygon = polygon.buffer(0)\n        if not polygon.is_empty:\n            polygons.append(polygon)\n    if not polygons:\n        # A degenerate contact still receives deterministic fail measurements.\n        minimum, maximum = mesh.bounds[:, :2]\n        return Polygon(\n            [\n                (minimum[0], minimum[1]),\n                (maximum[0], minimum[1]),\n                (maximum[0], maximum[1]),\n                (minimum[0], maximum[1]),\n            ]\n        )\n    return unary_union(polygons)\n\n\ndef _shortest_width(footprint: Any) -> float:\n    rectangle = footprint.minimum_rotated_rectangle\n    coordinates = list(rectangle.exterior.coords)\n    if len(coordinates) < 2:\n        return 0.0\n    lengths = [\n        float(np.hypot(b[0] - a[0], b[1] - a[1]))\n        for a, b in zip(coordinates, coordinates[1:])\n    ]\n    return min(lengths, default=0.0)\n\n\ndef check(\n    stl_bytes: bytes,\n    *,\n    min_base_area_mm2: float | None = None,\n    max_tip_ratio: float | None = None,\n) -> Report:\n    \"\"\"Measure an STL and return all five binding-v1 ejectability rules.\n\n    STL coordinates are expected to use the A1 plate coordinate system, whose\n    printable footprint is 0..256 mm on both X and Y.  The two numeric limits\n    may be overridden for assessment previews; the defaults are the binding v1\n    thresholds.\n    \"\"\"\n    if not isinstance(stl_bytes, (bytes, bytearray)):\n        raise ValueError(\"STL content must be bytes\")\n    if min_base_area_mm2 is not None:\n        min_base_area_mm2 = float(min_base_area_mm2)\n        if not math.isfinite(min_base_area_mm2) or min_base_area_mm2 < 0:\n            raise ValueError(\"min_base_area_mm2 must be a non-negative number\")\n    if max_tip_ratio is not None:\n        max_tip_ratio = float(max_tip_ratio)\n        if not math.isfinite(max_tip_ratio) or max_tip_ratio <= 0:\n            raise ValueError(\"max_tip_ratio must be a positive number\")\n    try:\n        mesh = trimesh.load(\n            BytesIO(bytes(stl_bytes)), file_type=\"stl\", force=\"mesh\", process=False\n        )\n    except Exception as exc:\n        raise ValueError(\"Could not read STL geometry\") from exc\n    if not isinstance(mesh, trimesh.Trimesh) or mesh.is_empty:\n        raise ValueError(\"STL contains no geometry\")\n    if not np.all(np.isfinite(mesh.bounds)):\n        raise ValueError(\"STL contains non-finite geometry\")\n\n    minimum, maximum = mesh.bounds\n    height = float(maximum[2] - minimum[2])\n    footprint = _base_footprint(mesh)\n    base_area = float(footprint.area)\n    shortest_width = _shortest_width(footprint)\n    tip_ratio = height / shortest_width if shortest_width > 0 else float(\"inf\")\n\n    low_height = height < NOZZLE_PUSH_HEIGHT_MM\n    wrong_gantry_branch = height <= GANTRY_PUSH_MIN_LAYER_Z_MM\n    area_threshold = MIN_BASE_AREA_MM2 if min_base_area_mm2 is None else min_base_area_mm2\n    ratio_threshold = MAX_TIP_RATIO if max_tip_ratio is None else max_tip_ratio\n    area_fail = base_area < area_threshold\n    tip_fail = tip_ratio > ratio_threshold\n    outside = (\n        float(footprint.bounds[0]) < 0.0\n        or float(footprint.bounds[1]) < 0.0\n        or float(footprint.bounds[2]) > BED_WIDTH_MM\n        or float(footprint.bounds[3]) > BED_DEPTH_MM\n    )\n\n    rules = (\n        Rule(\n            id=\"nozzle_push_height\",\n            measured=height,\n            threshold=f\"< {NOZZLE_PUSH_HEIGHT_MM:g} mm height\",\n            verdict=\"warn\" if low_height else \"pass\",\n            reason=(\n                \"Part is below gantry-push height; use the supervised nozzle-push \"\n                \"branch, including G1 Z1.\"\n                if low_height\n                else \"Part is not below the nozzle-push warning height.\"\n            ),\n        ),\n        Rule(\n            id=\"gantry_push_branch\",\n            measured=height,\n            threshold=f\"> {GANTRY_PUSH_MIN_LAYER_Z_MM:g} mm max_layer_z\",\n            verdict=\"warn\" if wrong_gantry_branch else \"pass\",\n            reason=(\n                \"The end block selects nozzle push because max_layer_z does not exceed 41 mm.\"\n                if wrong_gantry_branch\n                else \"The end block can select its gantry-push branch.\"\n            ),\n        ),\n        Rule(\n            id=\"base_area\",\n            measured=base_area,\n            threshold=f\">= {area_threshold:g} mm\u00b2\",\n            verdict=\"fail\" if area_fail else \"pass\",\n            reason=(\n                \"Projected base contact area is too small for adhesion release and push contact.\"\n                if area_fail\n                else \"Projected base contact area meets the v1 minimum.\"\n            ),\n        ),\n        Rule(\n            id=\"tip_ratio\",\n            measured=tip_ratio,\n            threshold=f\"<= {ratio_threshold:g}\",\n            verdict=\"fail\" if tip_fail else \"pass\",\n            reason=(\n                \"Height divided by shortest base-contact width exceeds the tip-over limit.\"\n                if tip_fail\n                else \"Height divided by shortest base-contact width is within the limit.\"\n            ),\n        ),\n        Rule(\n            id=\"bed_footprint\",\n            measured=not outside,\n            threshold=f\"{BED_WIDTH_MM:g} \u00d7 {BED_DEPTH_MM:g} mm A1 bed\",\n            verdict=\"fail\" if outside else \"pass\",\n            reason=(\n                \"The complete base footprint and its eject exit path do not fit the A1 envelope.\"\n                if outside\n                else \"The complete base footprint fits the A1 bed and eject clearance envelope.\"\n            ),\n        ),\n    )\n    if any(rule.verdict == \"fail\" for rule in rules):\n        verdict = \"fail\"\n    elif any(rule.verdict == \"warn\" for rule in rules):\n        verdict = \"warn\"\n    else:\n        verdict = \"pass\"\n    return Report(verdict=verdict, rules=rules)\n",
    "autoeject/end_block.py": "\"\"\"Build and safely evaluate the Factorian Designs A1 end block.\"\"\"\n\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport math\nimport re\nfrom collections.abc import Mapping\nfrom dataclasses import dataclass, fields\nfrom pathlib import Path\nfrom typing import Any\n\nMIN_BED_TEMP_C = 0\nMAX_BED_TEMP_C = 120\nMIN_HOLD_S = 0\nMAX_HOLD_S = 3600\nMIN_CYCLES = 1\nMAX_CYCLES = 100\nMIN_PUSH_FEEDRATE_MM_MIN = 1\nMAX_PUSH_FEEDRATE_MM_MIN = 18000\n\n_TEMPLATE_PATH = Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent / \"profiles\" / \"a1_end.gcode\"\n_PLACEHOLDER = re.compile(r\"\\{([^{}]+)\\}\")\n_ARITHMETIC = re.compile(r\"^(max_layer_z)(?:\\s*([+-])\\s*(\\d+(?:\\.\\d+)?))?$\")\n\n\n@dataclass(frozen=True)\nclass EjectBlockParams:\n    cool_bed_temp_c: int = 25\n    cool_hold_s: int = 120\n    heat_bed_temp_c: int = 60\n    heat_hold_s: int = 60\n    heat_cool_cycles: int = 1\n    push_feedrate_mm_min: int = 600\n\n\ndef _integer(name: str, value: Any, minimum: int, maximum: int) -> int:\n    if isinstance(value, bool) or not isinstance(value, int):\n        raise ValueError(f\"{name} must be an integer\")\n    if not minimum <= value <= maximum:\n        raise ValueError(f\"{name} must be between {minimum} and {maximum}\")\n    return value\n\n\ndef _validated_params(params: EjectBlockParams | Mapping[str, Any] | None) -> EjectBlockParams:\n    if params is None:\n        result = EjectBlockParams()\n    elif isinstance(params, EjectBlockParams):\n        result = params\n    elif isinstance(params, Mapping):\n        known = {field.name for field in fields(EjectBlockParams)}\n        unknown = set(params) - known\n        if unknown:\n            raise ValueError(f\"Unknown end-block parameter: {sorted(unknown)[0]}\")\n        try:\n            result = EjectBlockParams(**params)\n        except TypeError as exc:\n            raise ValueError(str(exc)) from exc\n    else:\n        raise ValueError(\"params must be an EjectBlockParams or a mapping\")\n\n    _integer(\"cool_bed_temp_c\", result.cool_bed_temp_c, MIN_BED_TEMP_C, MAX_BED_TEMP_C)\n    _integer(\"cool_hold_s\", result.cool_hold_s, MIN_HOLD_S, MAX_HOLD_S)\n    _integer(\"heat_bed_temp_c\", result.heat_bed_temp_c, MIN_BED_TEMP_C, MAX_BED_TEMP_C)\n    _integer(\"heat_hold_s\", result.heat_hold_s, MIN_HOLD_S, MAX_HOLD_S)\n    _integer(\"heat_cool_cycles\", result.heat_cool_cycles, MIN_CYCLES, MAX_CYCLES)\n    _integer(\n        \"push_feedrate_mm_min\",\n        result.push_feedrate_mm_min,\n        MIN_PUSH_FEEDRATE_MM_MIN,\n        MAX_PUSH_FEEDRATE_MM_MIN,\n    )\n    return result\n\n\ndef build_end_block(params: EjectBlockParams | Mapping[str, Any] | None = None) -> str:\n    \"\"\"Apply user parameters while retaining BambuStudio slicer placeholders.\"\"\"\n    settings = _validated_params(params)\n    template = _TEMPLATE_PATH.read_text(encoding=\"utf-8\")\n    cycles = []\n    for _ in range(settings.heat_cool_cycles):\n        cycles.extend(\n            [\n                f\"M190 S{settings.cool_bed_temp_c} ; wait for configured cool bed temperature\",\n                f\"G4 S{settings.cool_hold_s} ; hold at cool temperature\",\n                f\"M190 S{settings.heat_bed_temp_c} ; wait for configured heated bed temperature\",\n                f\"G4 S{settings.heat_hold_s} ; hold at heated temperature\",\n            ]\n        )\n    replacement = \"\\n\".join(\n        [\n            \"; --- ADDED: Special Cooling/Heating Sequence ---\",\n            *cycles,\n            \"; --- END Special Cooling/Heating Sequence ---\",\n            \"M140 S0 ; turn off bed\",\n            \"G4 S60 ; wait one minute for bed to cool fully\",\n            \"\",\n            \";======= Cool Down Done, Start Push Off =============\",\n        ]\n    )\n    pattern = re.compile(\n        r\"; --- ADDED: Special Cooling/Heating Sequence ---.*?\"\n        r\";======= Cool Down Done, Start Push Off =============\",\n        re.DOTALL,\n    )\n    block, count = pattern.subn(lambda _: replacement, template)\n    if count != 1:\n        raise ValueError(\"A1 end template does not contain exactly one heat/cool sequence\")\n    block, count = re.subn(\n        r\"(?m)^G1 Y-0\\.5 F300(\\s*;.*)$\",\n        f\"G1 Y-0.5 F{settings.push_feedrate_mm_min}\\\\1\",\n        block,\n    )\n    if count != 1:\n        raise ValueError(\"A1 end template does not contain exactly one push move\")\n    return block\n\n\ndef _number(value: float) -> str:\n    return f\"{value:.12g}\"\n\n\ndef _expression(expression: str, values: Mapping[str, Any]) -> str:\n    expression = expression.strip()\n    if expression == \"first_layer_center_no_wipe_tower[1]\":\n        try:\n            value = values[\"first_layer_center_no_wipe_tower\"][1]\n            if isinstance(value, bool) or not isinstance(value, (int, float)):\n                raise TypeError\n            if not math.isfinite(value):\n                raise ValueError\n            return _number(value)\n        except (KeyError, IndexError, TypeError, ValueError) as exc:\n            raise ValueError(\"Invalid first_layer_center_no_wipe_tower[1]\") from exc\n    match = _ARITHMETIC.fullmatch(expression)\n    if match:\n        try:\n            value = values[\"max_layer_z\"]\n            if isinstance(value, bool) or not isinstance(value, (int, float)):\n                raise TypeError\n            value = float(value)\n            if not math.isfinite(value):\n                raise ValueError\n        except (KeyError, TypeError, ValueError) as exc:\n            raise ValueError(\"Invalid max_layer_z\") from exc\n        if match.group(2):\n            operand = float(match.group(3))\n            value = value + operand if match.group(2) == \"+\" else value - operand\n        return _number(value)\n    raise ValueError(f\"Unsupported BambuStudio placeholder: {{{expression}}}\")\n\n\ndef _condition(condition: str, values: Mapping[str, Any]) -> bool:\n    compact = re.sub(r\"\\s+\", \"\", condition)\n    if compact == \"!spiral_mode&&print_sequence!=\\\"byobject\\\"\":\n        try:\n            spiral_mode = values[\"spiral_mode\"]\n            print_sequence = values[\"print_sequence\"]\n        except KeyError as exc:\n            raise ValueError(f\"Missing end-block value: {exc.args[0]}\") from exc\n        if not isinstance(spiral_mode, bool) or not isinstance(print_sequence, str):\n            raise ValueError(\"Invalid spiral_mode or print_sequence\")\n        return not spiral_mode and print_sequence != \"by object\"\n    if compact in {\"(max_layer_z)>41\", \"(max_layer_z+100.0)<256\"}:\n        try:\n            value = values[\"max_layer_z\"]\n            if isinstance(value, bool) or not isinstance(value, (int, float)):\n                raise TypeError\n            if not math.isfinite(value):\n                raise ValueError\n            return value > 41 if compact == \"(max_layer_z)>41\" else value + 100.0 < 256\n        except (KeyError, TypeError, ValueError) as exc:\n            raise ValueError(\"Invalid max_layer_z\") from exc\n    raise ValueError(f\"Unsupported BambuStudio conditional: {{if {condition}}}\")\n\n\ndef evaluate_end_block(block: str, values: Mapping[str, Any]) -> str:\n    \"\"\"Evaluate only the expressions and conditionals used by the A1 template.\n\n    Unknown placeholders and malformed conditional nesting are rejected rather\n    than being allowed to reach printer G-code.\n    \"\"\"\n    if not isinstance(block, str) or not isinstance(values, Mapping):\n        raise ValueError(\"block must be text and values must be a mapping\")\n\n    # Validate even placeholders in branches which will not be emitted.\n    for match in _PLACEHOLDER.finditer(block):\n        expression = match.group(1).strip()\n        if expression.startswith(\"if \") or expression in {\"else\", \"endif\"}:\n            if expression.startswith(\"if \"):\n                _condition(expression[3:], values)\n        else:\n            _expression(expression, values)\n\n    output: list[str] = []\n    # Each stack item is (parent_active, condition, in_else).\n    conditions: list[tuple[bool, bool, bool]] = []\n    active = True\n    for line in block.splitlines(keepends=True):\n        stripped = line.strip()\n        # Commented template directives remain comments but use the same syntax.\n        directive = stripped[1:].strip() if stripped.startswith(\";{\") else stripped\n        if directive.startswith(\"{if \") and directive.endswith(\"}\"):\n            condition = _condition(directive[4:-1], values)\n            conditions.append((active, condition, False))\n            active = active and condition\n        elif directive == \"{else}\":\n            if not conditions or conditions[-1][2]:\n                raise ValueError(\"Unexpected or duplicate {else}\")\n            parent, condition, _ = conditions.pop()\n            conditions.append((parent, condition, True))\n            active = parent and not condition\n        elif directive == \"{endif}\":\n            if not conditions:\n                raise ValueError(\"Unexpected {endif}\")\n            parent, _, _ = conditions.pop()\n            active = parent\n        elif active:\n            output.append(_PLACEHOLDER.sub(lambda m: _expression(m.group(1), values), line))\n    if conditions:\n        raise ValueError(\"Unclosed {if} block\")\n    result = \"\".join(output)\n    leftover = _PLACEHOLDER.search(result)\n    if leftover:\n        raise ValueError(f\"Unevaluated placeholder: {leftover.group(0)}\")\n    return result\n",
    "autoeject/loop.py": "\"\"\"Repeat an already sliced A1 executable block to print N copies in one job.\"\"\"\n\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nfrom .slicer import (\n    EXECUTABLE_BLOCK_END,\n    EXECUTABLE_BLOCK_START,\n    PLATE_GCODE_NAME,\n    PLATE_MD5_NAME,\n    assert_no_placeholders,\n    find_unique_line,\n    md5_hex,\n    read_archive,\n    rewrite_archive,\n)\n\nMIN_COPIES = 1\nMAX_COPIES = 100\n\n\ndef _copies(n: int) -> int:\n    if isinstance(n, bool) or not isinstance(n, int):\n        raise ValueError(\"n must be an integer\")\n    if not MIN_COPIES <= n <= MAX_COPIES:\n        raise ValueError(f\"n must be between {MIN_COPIES} and {MAX_COPIES}\")\n    return n\n\n\ndef loop_3mf(gcode_3mf_bytes: bytes, n: int) -> bytes:\n    \"\"\"Repeat the ``; EXECUTABLE_BLOCK_START``..``; EXECUTABLE_BLOCK_END`` body.\n\n    The body already contains the machine start, the print, the cooldown/eject\n    sequence and the machine end, so repeating it restores the starting\n    temperatures and initial conditions before every copy.  The plate MD5\n    companion is rewritten and raw placeholders on executable lines are\n    rejected.\n    \"\"\"\n    count = _copies(n)\n\n    entries = read_archive(gcode_3mf_bytes)\n    if PLATE_GCODE_NAME not in entries:\n        raise ValueError(f\"archive has no {PLATE_GCODE_NAME}\")\n    text = entries[PLATE_GCODE_NAME].decode(\"utf-8\")\n\n    lines = text.splitlines(keepends=True)\n    start = find_unique_line(lines, EXECUTABLE_BLOCK_START)\n    end = find_unique_line(lines, EXECUTABLE_BLOCK_END)\n    if end <= start:\n        raise ValueError(f\"{EXECUTABLE_BLOCK_END!r} must follow {EXECUTABLE_BLOCK_START!r}\")\n    body = lines[start + 1 : end]\n    if not body:\n        raise ValueError(\"executable block is empty\")\n\n    updated = \"\".join(lines[: start + 1] + body * count + lines[end:])\n    assert_no_placeholders(updated)\n\n    gcode_bytes = updated.encode(\"utf-8\")\n    return rewrite_archive(\n        gcode_3mf_bytes,\n        {\n            PLATE_GCODE_NAME: gcode_bytes,\n            PLATE_MD5_NAME: md5_hex(gcode_bytes).encode(\"ascii\"),\n        },\n    )\n",
    "autoeject/sim.py": "\"\"\"Minimal axis-aligned-box simulation of the evaluated A1 eject end block.\n\nThe simulator replays only the ``G0``/``G1``/``G90``/``G91`` moves of an\nalready evaluated eject block against four axis-aligned boxes:\n\n* the toolhead/nozzle box, following the programmed nozzle position,\n* the gantry bar, spanning X at the nozzle height,\n* the bed, which moves in Y and carries the part,\n* the part, positioned by the caller's bounding box.\n\nThe box dimensions below are deliberately approximate and are **not measured**\nfrom a real A1.  They exist to give deterministic, reproducible findings and a\nshort animation for the UI, not to make a physical safety claim.\n\"\"\"\n\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport math\nimport re\nfrom dataclasses import dataclass\nfrom typing import Any, Iterable, Sequence\n\nfrom .slicer import EXECUTABLE_BLOCK_END, MACHINE_END_START\n\n# --- approximate box dimensions, not measured ------------------------------\nTOOLHEAD_SIZE_MM = 40.0  # approximate, not measured\nTOOLHEAD_HEIGHT_MM = 40.0  # approximate, not measured\nGANTRY_BAR_Y_THICKNESS_MM = 10.0  # approximate, not measured\nGANTRY_BAR_Z_CLEARANCE_MM = 8.0  # approximate, not measured\nGANTRY_BAR_HEIGHT_MM = 60.0  # approximate, not measured\nBED_WIDTH_MM = 256.0  # approximate, not measured\nBED_DEPTH_MM = 256.0  # approximate, not measured\nBED_THICKNESS_MM = 5.0  # approximate, not measured\nOVERLAP_EPS_MM = 1e-6\n\n_NUMBER = r\"-?(?:\\d+(?:\\.\\d+)?|\\.\\d+)\"\n_COMMAND = re.compile(rf\"^([A-Za-z])\\s*({_NUMBER})?\")\n_WORD = re.compile(rf\"([A-Za-z])\\s*({_NUMBER})\")\n_LAYER_MARKER = re.compile(r\"^;\\s*(?:CHANGE_LAYER|LAYER_CHANGE)\\s*$\")\n_MAX_Z_HEIGHT = re.compile(r\"^;\\s*max_z_height:\\s*(-?[0-9.]+)\\s*$\")\n\n\n@dataclass(frozen=True)\nclass Box:\n    \"\"\"Axis-aligned bounding box in plate coordinates (millimetres).\"\"\"\n\n    xmin: float\n    ymin: float\n    zmin: float\n    xmax: float\n    ymax: float\n    zmax: float\n\n    @classmethod\n    def from_bounds(cls, bounds: Sequence[float]) -> \"Box\":\n        if len(bounds) != 6:\n            raise ValueError(\"part_bbox must have six values\")\n        values = [float(value) for value in bounds]\n        if not all(math.isfinite(value) for value in values):\n            raise ValueError(\"part_bbox must be finite\")\n        xmin, ymin, zmin, xmax, ymax, zmax = values\n        if xmin > xmax or ymin > ymax or zmin > zmax:\n            raise ValueError(\"part_bbox min values must not exceed max values\")\n        return cls(xmin, ymin, zmin, xmax, ymax, zmax)\n\n    @property\n    def center_x(self) -> float:\n        return (self.xmin + self.xmax) / 2.0\n\n    @property\n    def center_y(self) -> float:\n        return (self.ymin + self.ymax) / 2.0\n\n\n@dataclass(frozen=True)\nclass Move:\n    \"\"\"One replayed spatial G0/G1 move.\"\"\"\n\n    i: int\n    x: float\n    y: float\n    z: float\n    feedrate: float | None = None\n\n    def to_dict(self) -> dict[str, float | int]:\n        return {\"i\": self.i, \"x\": self.x, \"y\": self.y, \"z\": self.z}\n\n\n@dataclass(frozen=True)\nclass Collision:\n    \"\"\"A toolhead or gantry box that hit the part outside a Y push move.\"\"\"\n\n    move_index: int\n    box: str\n\n    def to_dict(self) -> dict[str, Any]:\n        return {\"move_index\": self.move_index, \"box\": self.box}\n\n\n@dataclass(frozen=True)\nclass SimReport:\n    \"\"\"Deterministic simulation result for the UI and the API.\"\"\"\n\n    pushed: bool\n    pushed_by: tuple[str, ...]\n    collisions: tuple[Collision, ...]\n    moves: tuple[Move, ...]\n    unknown_commands: int\n\n    @property\n    def missed_push(self) -> bool:\n        return not self.pushed\n\n    def to_dict(self) -> dict[str, Any]:\n        return {\n            \"pushed\": self.pushed,\n            \"pushed_by\": list(self.pushed_by),\n            \"missed_push\": self.missed_push,\n            \"collisions\": [collision.to_dict() for collision in self.collisions],\n            \"moves\": [move.to_dict() for move in self.moves],\n            \"unknown_commands\": self.unknown_commands,\n        }\n\n\ndef _overlaps(a_min: float, a_max: float, b_min: float, b_max: float) -> bool:\n    \"\"\"Strict overlap so merely touching a face is not a collision.\"\"\"\n    return a_min < b_max - OVERLAP_EPS_MM and a_max > b_min + OVERLAP_EPS_MM\n\n\ndef _hits(box: Box, part: Box) -> bool:\n    return (\n        _overlaps(box.xmin, box.xmax, part.xmin, part.xmax)\n        and _overlaps(box.ymin, box.ymax, part.ymin, part.ymax)\n        and _overlaps(box.zmin, box.zmax, part.zmin, part.zmax)\n    )\n\n\ndef _swept(previous: tuple[float, float, float], current: tuple[float, float, float]):\n    \"\"\"Return the toolhead and gantry boxes swept by one move.\"\"\"\n    px, py, pz = previous\n    cx, cy, cz = current\n    toolhead = Box(\n        min(px, cx) - TOOLHEAD_SIZE_MM / 2.0,\n        min(py, cy) - TOOLHEAD_SIZE_MM / 2.0,\n        min(pz, cz),\n        max(px, cx) + TOOLHEAD_SIZE_MM / 2.0,\n        max(py, cy) + TOOLHEAD_SIZE_MM / 2.0,\n        max(pz, cz) + TOOLHEAD_HEIGHT_MM,\n    )\n    gantry = Box(\n        0.0,\n        min(py, cy) - GANTRY_BAR_Y_THICKNESS_MM / 2.0,\n        min(pz, cz) + GANTRY_BAR_Z_CLEARANCE_MM,\n        BED_WIDTH_MM,\n        max(py, cy) + GANTRY_BAR_Y_THICKNESS_MM / 2.0,\n        max(pz, cz) + GANTRY_BAR_Z_CLEARANCE_MM + GANTRY_BAR_HEIGHT_MM,\n    )\n    return toolhead, gantry\n\n\ndef _strip_comment(line: str) -> str:\n    return line.split(\";\", 1)[0].strip()\n\n\ndef _words(rest: str) -> dict[str, float]:\n    return {letter.upper(): float(value) for letter, value in _WORD.findall(rest)}\n\n\ndef simulate(eject_gcode_evaluated: str, part_bbox: Any) -> SimReport:\n    \"\"\"Replay an evaluated eject block and report push/collision findings.\n\n    ``part_bbox`` is the part's real axis-aligned box in plate coordinates as\n    ``(xmin, ymin, zmin, xmax, ymax, zmax)`` (a ``(2, 3)`` trimesh-style bounds\n    array is also accepted).  Only ``G0``/``G1``/``G90``/``G91`` are understood;\n    every other command is ignored and counted in ``unknown_commands``.\n    \"\"\"\n    if not isinstance(eject_gcode_evaluated, str):\n        raise ValueError(\"eject_gcode_evaluated must be text\")\n\n    bounds = getattr(part_bbox, \"bounds\", None)\n    if bounds is not None and bounds is not part_bbox:\n        part = Box.from_bounds(list(bounds.reshape(-1)))\n    else:\n        part = Box.from_bounds(part_bbox)\n\n    # The block starts where printing stopped: over the part, at its top surface.\n    x, y, z = part.center_x, part.center_y, part.zmax\n    absolute = True\n    feedrate: float | None = None\n\n    moves: list[Move] = []\n    collisions: list[Collision] = []\n    pushed_by: set[str] = set()\n    ejected = False\n    unknown = 0\n\n    for raw_line in eject_gcode_evaluated.splitlines():\n        line = _strip_comment(raw_line)\n        if not line:\n            continue\n        match = _COMMAND.match(line)\n        if not match:\n            unknown += 1\n            continue\n        letter = match.group(1).upper()\n        number = match.group(2)\n\n        if letter == \"G\" and number in {\"0\", \"1\"}:\n            params = _words(line[match.end(1) :])\n            if \"F\" in params:\n                feedrate = params[\"F\"]\n            previous = (x, y, z)\n            if absolute:\n                next_x = params.get(\"X\", x)\n                next_y = params.get(\"Y\", y)\n                next_z = params.get(\"Z\", z)\n            else:\n                next_x = x + params[\"X\"] if \"X\" in params else x\n                next_y = y + params[\"Y\"] if \"Y\" in params else y\n                next_z = z + params[\"Z\"] if \"Z\" in params else z\n            if (next_x, next_y, next_z) == previous:\n                continue\n\n            toolhead, gantry = _swept(previous, (next_x, next_y, next_z))\n            contact = [\n                name\n                for name, box in ((\"nozzle\", toolhead), (\"gantry\", gantry))\n                if _hits(box, part)\n            ]\n            if contact and not ejected:\n                has_y_motion = abs(next_y - y) > OVERLAP_EPS_MM\n                if has_y_motion:\n                    # The Y push is the intended ejection move.\n                    pushed_by.update(contact)\n                    ejected = True\n                else:\n                    # Any other box contact is an unintended collision.\n                    move_index = len(moves)\n                    collisions.extend(\n                        Collision(move_index=move_index, box=name)\n                        for name in contact\n                    )\n\n            x, y, z = next_x, next_y, next_z\n            moves.append(Move(len(moves), x, y, z, feedrate))\n        elif letter == \"G\" and number == \"90\":\n            absolute = True\n        elif letter == \"G\" and number == \"91\":\n            absolute = False\n        else:\n            unknown += 1\n\n    return SimReport(\n        pushed=bool(pushed_by),\n        pushed_by=tuple(sorted(pushed_by)),\n        collisions=tuple(collisions),\n        moves=tuple(moves),\n        unknown_commands=unknown,\n    )\n\n\ndef extract_end_block(gcode_text: str) -> str:\n    \"\"\"Return the text from ``; MACHINE_END_GCODE_START`` through the block end.\n\n    The eject simulation and preview only care about the end block, so callers\n    pass this slice rather than a whole printed plate.\n    \"\"\"\n    if not isinstance(gcode_text, str):\n        raise ValueError(\"gcode_text must be text\")\n    start = gcode_text.find(MACHINE_END_START)\n    if start < 0 or gcode_text.find(MACHINE_END_START, start + 1) >= 0:\n        raise ValueError(f\"expected exactly one {MACHINE_END_START!r} marker\")\n    end = gcode_text.find(EXECUTABLE_BLOCK_END, start)\n    if end < 0 or gcode_text.find(EXECUTABLE_BLOCK_END, end + 1) >= 0:\n        raise ValueError(f\"expected exactly one {EXECUTABLE_BLOCK_END!r} marker\")\n    return gcode_text[start : end + len(EXECUTABLE_BLOCK_END)]\n\n\ndef part_bbox_from_gcode(gcode_text: str) -> tuple[float, float, float, float, float, float]:\n    \"\"\"Derive a part box from header ``max_z_height`` and the first layer.\n\n    The XY extent comes from the first layer's extrusion moves, which is the\n    base footprint that actually sits on the plate.  This is the pre-sliced\n    counterpart of measuring an STL's bounds.\n    \"\"\"\n    if not isinstance(gcode_text, str):\n        raise ValueError(\"gcode_text must be text\")\n    lines = gcode_text.splitlines()\n\n    max_z: float | None = None\n    for line in lines:\n        match = _MAX_Z_HEIGHT.match(line.strip())\n        if match:\n            max_z = float(match.group(1))\n            break\n    if max_z is None or not math.isfinite(max_z):\n        raise ValueError(\"gcode has no finite max_z_height header\")\n\n    markers = [i for i, line in enumerate(lines) if _LAYER_MARKER.match(line.strip())]\n    if not markers:\n        start, stop = 0, len(lines)\n    else:\n        start = markers[0] + 1\n        stop = markers[1] if len(markers) > 1 else len(lines)\n\n    extrusion_x: list[float] = []\n    extrusion_y: list[float] = []\n    loose_x: list[float] = []\n    loose_y: list[float] = []\n    for raw_line in lines[start:stop]:\n        line = _strip_comment(raw_line)\n        if not line:\n            continue\n        match = _COMMAND.match(line)\n        if not match or match.group(1).upper() != \"G\" or match.group(2) not in {\"0\", \"1\"}:\n            continue\n        params = _words(line[match.end(1) :])\n        if \"X\" not in params or \"Y\" not in params:\n            continue\n        loose_x.append(params[\"X\"])\n        loose_y.append(params[\"Y\"])\n        if params.get(\"E\", 0.0) > 0.0:\n            extrusion_x.append(params[\"X\"])\n            extrusion_y.append(params[\"Y\"])\n\n    xs = extrusion_x or loose_x\n    ys = extrusion_y or loose_y\n    if not xs or not ys:\n        raise ValueError(\"first layer has no XY moves to measure\")\n    return (min(xs), min(ys), 0.0, max(xs), max(ys), max_z)\n",
    "autoeject/slicer.py": "\"\"\"Headless A1 slicing and safe end-block injection for ``.gcode.3mf`` files.\n\nTwo independent entry points live here:\n\n* :func:`slice_stl` drives the BambuStudio CLI with the CLI's own installed\n  system profiles, patching only ``machine_end_gcode`` in a copy of the A1\n  machine profile.\n* :func:`inject_end_block` rewrites the evaluated stock end block of an\n  already sliced A1 ``.gcode.3mf``.\n\nBoth keep the archive valid by recomputing ``Metadata/plate_1.gcode.md5``.\n\"\"\"\n\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport hashlib\nimport json\nimport os\nimport re\nimport subprocess\nimport tempfile\nimport zipfile\nfrom io import BytesIO\nfrom pathlib import Path\nfrom typing import Any\n\nfrom .end_block import evaluate_end_block\n\nPLATE_GCODE_NAME = \"Metadata/plate_1.gcode\"\nPLATE_MD5_NAME = \"Metadata/plate_1.gcode.md5\"\nPLATE_JSON_NAME = \"Metadata/plate_1.json\"\n\nMACHINE_END_START = \"; MACHINE_END_GCODE_START\"\nEXECUTABLE_BLOCK_START = \"; EXECUTABLE_BLOCK_START\"\nEXECUTABLE_BLOCK_END = \"; EXECUTABLE_BLOCK_END\"\n\nA1_MACHINE_PROFILE = \"Bambu Lab A1 0.4 nozzle\"\n\n_PLACEHOLDER = re.compile(r\"\\{[^{}]*\\}\")\n_SAFE_POS = re.compile(r\"^G1\\s+X(-?[\\d.]+)\\s+Y(-?[\\d.]+)\\s+F18000\\b\")\n\n\nclass SliceError(RuntimeError):\n    \"\"\"Raised when headless slicing cannot produce a plate archive.\"\"\"\n\n\n# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n# Archive helpers\n# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n\n\ndef read_archive(archive_bytes: bytes) -> dict[str, bytes]:\n    \"\"\"Return ``name -> bytes`` for every member of a ZIP-based 3MF.\"\"\"\n    if not isinstance(archive_bytes, (bytes, bytearray)):\n        raise ValueError(\"archive content must be bytes\")\n    try:\n        with zipfile.ZipFile(BytesIO(bytes(archive_bytes))) as archive:\n            if archive.testzip() is not None:\n                raise ValueError(\"archive is corrupt\")\n            return {info.filename: archive.read(info) for info in archive.infolist()}\n    except zipfile.BadZipFile as exc:\n        raise ValueError(\"not a ZIP-based .gcode.3mf archive\") from exc\n\n\ndef
