turn on mech mode supression\r\nG90\r\nM83\r\nT1000\r\n\r\nM211 X0 Y0 Z0 ;turn off soft endstop\r\n;G392 S1 ; turn on clog detection\r\nM1007 S1 ; turn on mass estimation\r\nG29.4\r\n\r\nG0 E2.2 F800 ; Extrude a little so nozzle is filled for print start you might have to increase this up to E2.5 depending on your filament\r\nM104 S{nozzle_temperature_initial_layer[initial_extruder]} ; heat up to full temp in first few moves",
    "pyproject.toml": "[project]\nname = \"autoeject\"\nversion = \"0.1.0\"\ndescription = \"Core geometry and eject G-code tools for the Bambu Lab A1\"\nrequires-python = \">=3.13\"\ndependencies = [\n    \"fastapi>=0.115\",\n    \"numpy>=2.0\",\n    \"python-multipart>=0.0.9\",\n    \"shapely>=2.0\",\n    \"trimesh>=4.0\",\n    \"uvicorn>=0.30\",\n]\n\n[build-system]\nrequires = [\"hatchling\"]\nbuild-backend = \"hatchling.build\"\n\n[tool.hatch.build.targets.wheel]\npackages = [\"autoeject\"]\n\n[dependency-groups]\ndev = [\"httpx>=0.27\", \"pytest>=8.0\"]\n",
    "railway.toml": "[build]\nbuilder = \"DOCKERFILE\"\ndockerfilePath = \"Dockerfile\"\n\n[deploy]\nstartCommand = \"uvicorn app.main:app --host 0.0.0.0 --port $PORT\"\nhealthcheckPath = \"/api/health\"\nhealthcheckTimeout = 60\nrestartPolicyType = \"ON_FAILURE\"\n",
    "tests/test_app.py": "\"\"\"End-to-end tests for the FastAPI surface, calling the real autoeject core.\n\nNothing here is mocked across a module boundary: ``TestClient`` drives the real\nhandlers and those handlers call the real :mod:`autoeject` functions.  There is\nno printer, network or BambuStudio dependency.\n\"\"\"\n\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport hashlib\nfrom pathlib import Path\n\nimport trimesh\nfrom fastapi.testclient import TestClient\n\nfrom app.main import app\nfrom autoeject.slicer import PLATE_GCODE_NAME, PLATE_MD5_NAME, read_archive\n\nFIXTURE = Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent / \"fixtures\" / \"real_a1.gcode.3mf\"\n\nclient = TestClient(app)\n\n\ndef _stl(mesh: trimesh.Trimesh) -> bytes:\n    return mesh.export(file_type=\"stl\")\n\n\ndef _centered_box(x: float, y: float, z: float) -> trimesh.Trimesh:\n    mesh = trimesh.creation.box(extents=(x, y, z))\n    mesh.apply_translation((128, 128, z / 2))\n    return mesh\n\n\ndef test_check_40_mm_cube_returns_warn_verdict():\n    response = client.post(\n        \"/api/check\",\n        files={\"file\": (\"cube.stl\", _stl(_centered_box(40, 40, 40)), \"model/stl\")},\n    )\n    assert response.status_code == 200\n    payload = response.json()\n    assert payload[\"verdict\"] == \"warn\"\n    assert payload[\"measurements\"][\"base_area\"] == 1600\n    assert payload[\"preview\"][\"bounds\"][5] == 40\n    assert {rule[\"id\"] for rule in payload[\"rules\"]} >= {\n        \"nozzle_push_height\",\n        \"gantry_push_branch\",\n        \"base_area\",\n        \"tip_ratio\",\n        \"bed_footprint\",\n    }\n\n\ndef test_build_real_fixture_n3_returns_three_pushes_and_matching_md5():\n    response = client.post(\n        \"/api/build\",\n        files={\n            \"file\": (\n                \"real_a1.gcode.3mf\",\n                FIXTURE.read_bytes(),\n                \"application/octet-stream\",\n            )\n        },\n        data={\"n\": \"3\"},\n    )\n    assert response.status_code == 200\n    assert response.headers[\"content-type\"] == \"application/octet-stream\"\n\n    entries = read_archive(response.content)\n    gcode = entries[PLATE_GCODE_NAME].decode(\"utf-8\")\n    assert gcode.count(\"G1 Y-0.5 F600\") == 3\n    recorded = entries[PLATE_MD5_NAME].decode(\"ascii\").strip()\n    assert recorded == hashlib.md5(entries[PLATE_GCODE_NAME]).hexdigest().upper()\n\n\ndef test_simulate_generated_job_reports_push_without_collisions():\n    built = client.post(\n        \"/api/build\",\n        files={\n            \"file\": (\n                \"real_a1.gcode.3mf\",\n                FIXTURE.read_bytes(),\n                \"application/octet-stream\",\n            )\n        },\n        data={\"n\": \"3\"},\n    )\n    assert built.status_code == 200\n\n    response = client.post(\n        \"/api/simulate\",\n        files={\n            \"file\": (\n                \"autoeject_a1.gcode.3mf\",\n                built.content,\n                \"application/octet-stream\",\n            )\n        },\n    )\n    assert response.status_code == 200\n    payload = response.json()\n    assert payload[\"pushed\"] is True\n    assert payload[\"missed_push\"] is False\n    assert payload[\"collisions\"] == []\n    assert len(payload[\"moves\"]) > 0\n\n\ndef test_build_blocks_a_part_off_the_bed_with_a_reason():\n    mesh = _centered_box(40, 40, 40)\n    mesh.apply_translation((200, 0, 0))\n    response = client.post(\n        \"/api/build\",\n        files={\"file\": (\"off_bed.stl\", _stl(mesh), \"model/stl\")},\n        data={\"n\": \"1\"},\n    )\n    assert response.status_code == 422\n    payload = response.json()\n    assert payload[\"verdict\"] == \"fail\"\n    assert any(\"footprint\" in reason for reason in payload[\"reasons\"])\n\n\ndef test_check_rejects_an_archive_upload():\n    response = client.post(\n        \"/api/check\",\n        files={\n            \"file\": (\n                \"real_a1.gcode.3mf\",\n                FIXTURE.read_bytes(),\n                \"application/octet-stream\",\n            )\n        },\n    )\n    assert response.status_code == 422\n\n\ndef test_static_index_is_served():\n    response = client.get(\"/\")\n    assert response.status_code == 200\n    assert \"Auto-eject A1\" in response.text\n    assert \"three.js\" in response.text\n",
    "tests/test_ejectability.py": "import trimesh\n\nfrom autoeject.ejectability import check\n\n\ndef stl(mesh):\n    return mesh.export(file_type=\"stl\")\n\n\ndef centered_box(x, y, z):\n    mesh = trimesh.creation.box(extents=(x, y, z))\n    mesh.apply_translation((128, 128, z / 2))\n    return mesh\n\n\ndef rule(report, rule_id):\n    return next(item for item in report.rules if item.id == rule_id)\n\n\ndef test_40_mm_cube_warns_only_about_gantry_branch_threshold():\n    report = check(stl(centered_box(40, 40, 40)))\n    assert report.verdict == \"warn\"\n    assert rule(report, \"nozzle_push_height\").verdict == \"pass\"\n    assert rule(report, \"base_area\").measured == 1600\n    assert report.to_dict()[\"rules\"][0][\"id\"] == \"nozzle_push_height\"\n\n\ndef test_20_mm_cube_warns_and_does_not_fail():\n    first = check(stl(centered_box(20, 20, 20)))\n    second = check(stl(centered_box(20, 20, 20)))\n    assert first.verdict == \"warn\"\n    assert not any(item.verdict == \"fail\" for item in first.rules)\n    assert rule(first, \"nozzle_push_height\").verdict == \"warn\"\n    assert first.to_dict() == second.to_dict()\n\n\ndef test_tall_thin_rod_fails_tip_ratio():\n    report = check(stl(centered_box(10, 10, 100)))\n    assert report.verdict == \"fail\"\n    assert rule(report, \"tip_ratio\").measured == 10\n    assert rule(report, \"tip_ratio\").verdict == \"fail\"\n\n\ndef test_small_contact_area_fails():\n    report = check(stl(centered_box(4, 20, 20)))\n    assert rule(report, \"base_area\").verdict == \"fail\"\n\n\ndef test_part_off_bed_fails_footprint():\n    mesh = centered_box(40, 40, 40)\n    mesh.apply_translation((200, 0, 0))\n    report = check(stl(mesh))\n    assert report.verdict == \"fail\"\n    assert rule(report, \"bed_footprint\").verdict == \"fail\"\n",
    "tests/test_end_block.py": "import pytest\n\nfrom autoeject.end_block import EjectBlockParams, build_end_block, evaluate_end_block\n\n\nVALUES = {\n    \"max_layer_z\": 20.08,\n    \"first_layer_center_no_wipe_tower\": [128.0, 128.0],\n    \"spiral_mode\": False,\n    \"print_sequence\": \"by layer\",\n}\n\n\ndef test_build_substitutes_parameters_and_retains_slicer_placeholders():\n    block = build_end_block(\n        EjectBlockParams(\n            cool_bed_temp_c=22,\n            cool_hold_s=90,\n            heat_bed_temp_c=65,\n            heat_hold_s=45,\n            heat_cool_cycles=2,\n            push_feedrate_mm_min=450,\n        )\n    )\n    assert block.count(\"M190 S22 ;\") == 2\n    assert block.count(\"M190 S65 ;\") == 2\n    assert block.count(\"G4 S90 ;\") == 2\n    assert block.count(\"G4 S45 ;\") == 2\n    assert \"G1 Y-0.5 F450\" in block\n    assert \"{if (max_layer_z ) > 41}\" in block\n    assert \"{max_layer_z + 0.5}\" in block\n\n\n@pytest.mark.parametrize(\n    \"params\",\n    [\n        {\"heat_cool_cycles\": 0},\n        {\"cool_bed_temp_c\": -1},\n        {\"heat_bed_temp_c\": 121},\n        {\"cool_hold_s\": -1},\n        {\"heat_hold_s\": 3601},\n        {\"push_feedrate_mm_min\": 0},\n        {\"unknown\": 1},\n    ],\n)\ndef test_invalid_parameters_fail(params):\n    with pytest.raises(ValueError):\n        build_end_block(params)\n\n\ndef test_20_08_evaluates_nozzle_push_with_z1():\n    result = evaluate_end_block(build_end_block(), VALUES)\n    assert \"G1 Z1 F600\" in result\n    assert \"G1 Z-19.92 F600\" not in result\n    assert \"G1 Z20.58 F900\" in result\n    for line in result.splitlines():\n        if not line.lstrip().startswith(\";\"):\n            assert \"{\" not in line\n\n\ndef test_60_evaluates_gantry_push_with_z20():\n    result = evaluate_end_block(build_end_block(), {**VALUES, \"max_layer_z\": 60})\n    assert \"G1 Z20 F600\" in result\n    assert \"G1 Z60.5 F900\" in result\n\n\ndef test_unknown_placeholder_fails_closed_even_in_unused_branch():\n    block = \"{if (max_layer_z ) > 41}\\nG1 X{unknown}\\n{else}\\nG1 X0\\n{endif}\\n\"\n    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match=\"Unsupported\"):\n        evaluate_end_block(block, VALUES)\n",
    "tests/test_loop.py": "import hashlib\nfrom pathlib import Path\n\nimport pytest\n\nfrom autoeject.end_block import EjectBlockParams, build_end_block\nfrom autoeject.loop import loop_3mf\nfrom autoeject.slicer import (\n    PLATE_GCODE_NAME,\n    PLATE_MD5_NAME,\n    inject_end_block,\n    read_archive,\n)\n\nFIXTURE = Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent / \"fixtures\" / \"real_a1.gcode.3mf\"\n\nTEMPLATE = build_end_block(\n    EjectBlockParams(\n        cool_bed_temp_c=25,\n        cool_hold_s=120,\n        heat_bed_temp_c=60,\n        heat_hold_s=60,\n        heat_cool_cycles=2,\n        push_feedrate_mm_min=600,\n    )\n)\n\n\ndef injected_fixture() -> bytes:\n    return inject_end_block(FIXTURE.read_bytes(), TEMPLATE)\n\n\ndef test_loop_n3_repeats_print_and_eject_from_the_real_fixture():\n    result = loop_3mf(injected_fixture(), 3)\n    entries = read_archive(result)\n    gcode = entries[PLATE_GCODE_NAME].decode(\"utf-8\")\n\n    # Three ordered print bodies and three eject sequences.\n    assert gcode.count(\"; EXECUTABLE_BLOCK_START\") == 1\n    assert gcode.count(\"; EXECUTABLE_BLOCK_END\") == 1\n    assert gcode.count(\"G1 Y-0.5 F600\") == 3\n    # Two low-Z moves per copy: the nozzle-push selection and the safety clear.\n    assert gcode.count(\"G1 Z1 F600\") == 6\n\n    # Two configured cool-and-heat cycles per copy.\n    assert gcode.count(\"M190 S25 ;\") == 6\n    assert gcode.count(\"M190 S60 ;\") == 6\n    assert gcode.count(\"G4 S120 ; hold at cool temperature\") == 6\n    assert gcode.count(\"G4 S60 ; hold at heated temperature\") == 6\n\n    # Matching md5 and no raw placeholders on executable lines.\n    recorded = entries[PLATE_MD5_NAME].decode(\"ascii\").strip()\n    assert recorded == hashlib.md5(entries[PLATE_GCODE_NAME]).hexdigest().upper()\n    for line in gcode.splitlines():\n        if not line.lstrip().startswith(\";\"):\n            assert \"{\" not in line and \"}\" not in line\n\n\ndef test_loop_n1_is_a_single_printable_copy():\n    result = loop_3mf(injected_fixture(), 1)\n    gcode = read_archive(result)[PLATE_GCODE_NAME].decode(\"utf-8\")\n    assert gcode.count(\"G1 Y-0.5 F600\") == 1\n\n\n@pytest.mark.parametrize(\"n\", [0, -1, 101, True, \"3\", None])\ndef test_loop_rejects_invalid_iteration_counts(n):\n    with pytest.raises(ValueError):\n        loop_3mf(injected_fixture(), n)\n\n\ndef test_loop_rejects_archive_without_executable_block():\n    with pytest.raises(ValueError):\n        loop_3mf(b\"not a zip\", 3)\n\n\ndef test_loop_rejects_placeholder_on_an_executable_line(monkeypatch):\n    import io\n    import zipfile\n\n    gcode = (\n        \"; EXECUTABLE_BLOCK_START\\n\"\n        \"G1 Z{max_layer_z + 0.5} F900\\n\"\n        \"; EXECUTABLE_BLOCK_END\\n\"\n    ).encode(\"utf-8\")\n    buffer = io.BytesIO()\n    with zipfile.ZipFile(buffer, \"w\") as archive:\n        archive.writestr(PLATE_GCODE_NAME, gcode)\n    with pytest.raises(ValueError):\n        loop_3mf(buffer.getvalue(), 3)\n",
    "tests/test_sim.py": "from pathlib import Path\n\nimport pytest\n\nfrom autoeject.end_block import build_end_block\nfrom autoeject.sim import (\n    extract_end_block,\n    part_bbox_from_gcode,\n    simulate,\n)\nfrom autoeject.slicer import (\n    PLATE_GCODE_NAME,\n    inject_end_block,\n    read_archive,\n)\n\nFIXTURE = Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent / \"fixtures\" / \"real_a1.gcode.3mf\"\n\n\ndef cube_bbox(size):\n    half = size / 2.0\n    return (128.0 - half, 128.0 - half, 0.0, 128.0 + half, 128.0 + half, float(size))\n\n\nGANTRY_PUSH = (\n    \"G90\\n\"\n    \"G1 Z40.5 F600\\n\"\n    \"G1 X-48 Y262 F3600\\n\"\n    \"G1 Z20 F600\\n\"\n    \"G1 Y-0.5 F300\\n\"\n)\n\nNOZZLE_PUSH = (\n    \"G90\\n\"\n    \"G1 Z20.5 F600\\n\"\n    \"G1 X128 Y262 F3600\\n\"\n    \"G1 Z15 F600\\n\"\n    \"G1 Y-0.5 F300\\n\"\n)\n\n\ndef test_40_mm_cube_is_pushed_by_the_gantry():\n    report = simulate(GANTRY_PUSH, cube_bbox(40))\n    assert report.pushed is True\n    assert report.pushed_by == (\"gantry\",)\n    assert report.collisions == ()\n\n\ndef test_20_mm_cube_is_pushed_by_the_nozzle():\n    report = simulate(NOZZLE_PUSH, cube_bbox(20))\n    assert report.pushed is True\n    assert report.pushed_by == (\"nozzle\",)\n    assert report.collisions == ()\n\n\ndef test_push_line_removed_reports_a_missed_push():\n    block = GANTRY_PUSH.replace(\"G1 Y-0.5 F300\\n\", \"\")\n    report = simulate(block, cube_bbox(40))\n    assert report.pushed is False\n    assert report.missed_push is True\n    assert report.pushed_by == ()\n\n\ndef test_y_push_that_misses_the_part_reports_a_missed_push():\n    block = \"G90\\nG1 X-48 Y262 F3600\\nG1 Z20 F600\\nG1 Y200 F300\\n\"\n    report = simulate(block, cube_bbox(40))\n    assert report.pushed is False\n    assert report.missed_push is True\n\n\ndef test_non_push_contact_reports_a_collision_with_its_move_index():\n    # Driving the nozzle down onto the part is a Z move, not a Y push.\n    block = \"G90\\nG1 Z20 F600\\n\"\n    report = simulate(block, cube_bbox(40))\n    assert report.pushed is False\n    assert {collision.move_index for collision in report.collisions} == {0}\n    assert {collision.box for collision in report.collisions} == {\"nozzle\", \"gantry\"}\n\n\ndef test_unknown_commands_are_ignored_and_counted():\n    block = (\n        \"G90\\n\"\n        \"M400 ; wait for buffer\\n\"\n        \"T255\\n\"\n        \"G1 Z40.5 F600\\n\"\n        \"G1 X-48 Y262 F3600\\n\"\n        \"G1 Z20 F600\\n\"\n        \"G1 Y-0.5 F300\\n\"\n        \"M18 X Y Z\\n\"\n    )\n    report = simulate(block, cube_bbox(40))\n    assert report.pushed is True\n    assert report.unknown_commands == 3\n\n\ndef test_move_list_is_json_friendly_for_the_ui():\n    report = simulate(GANTRY_PUSH, cube_bbox(40))\n    payload = report.to_dict()\n    assert [move[\"i\"] for move in payload[\"moves\"]] == list(\n        range(len(payload[\"moves\"]))\n    )\n    for move in payload[\"moves\"]:\n        assert set(move) == {\"i\", \"x\", \"y\", \"z\"}\n\n\ndef test_relative_moves_are_supported():\n    absolute = simulate(\"G90\\nG1 Z40.5 F600\\nG1 Y262 F3600\\nG1 Z20\\nG1 Y-0.5 F300\\n\", cube_bbox(40))\n    relative = simulate(\"G90\\nG1 Z40.5 F600\\nG91\\nG1 Y134 F3600\\nG1 Z-20.5\\nG1 Y-262.5 F300\\n\", cube_bbox(40))\n    assert absolute.pushed is True\n    assert relative.pushed is True\n    assert absolute.moves[-1].y == relative.moves[-1].y\n\n\ndef test_part_bbox_from_gcode_and_end_block_extraction():\n    injected = inject_end_block(FIXTURE.read_bytes(), build_end_block())\n    gcode = read_archive(injected)[PLATE_GCODE_NAME].decode(\"utf-8\")\n\n    bbox = part_bbox_from_gcode(gcode)\n    assert bbox[2] == 0.0\n    assert bbox[5] == 20.08\n    assert 0.0 < bbox[0] < bbox[3] < 256.0\n    assert 0.0 < bbox[1] < bbox[4] < 256.0\n\n    block = extract_end_block(gcode)\n    assert block.startswith(\"; MACHINE_END_GCODE_START\")\n    assert block.rstrip().endswith(\"; EXECUTABLE_BLOCK_END\")\n\n\ndef test_real_a1_fixture_is_pushed_without_collisions():\n    injected = inject_end_block(FIXTURE.read_bytes(), build_end_block())\n    gcode = read_archive(injected)[PLATE_GCODE_NAME].decode(\"utf-8\")\n    report = simulate(extract_end_block(gcode), part_bbox_from_gcode(gcode))\n\n    assert report.pushed is True\n    assert report.collisions == ()\n    assert report.pushed_by == (\"gantry\",)\n    assert report.unknown_commands > 0\n\n\ndef test_invalid_part_bbox_is_rejected():\n    with pytest.raises(ValueError):\n        simulate(GANTRY_PUSH, (0.0, 0.0, 0.0))\n    with pytest.raises(ValueError):\n        simulate(GANTRY_PUSH, (10.0, 0.0, 0.0, 5.0, 5.0, 5.0))\n\n\ndef test_part_bbox_from_gcode_without_extrusions_falls_back():\n    gcode = (\n        \"; max_z_height: 5.0\\n\"\n        \"; CHANGE_LAYER\\n\"\n        \"G1 X10 Y20 F3000\\n\"\n        \"G1 X30 Y40 F3000\\n\"\n    )\n    assert part_bbox_from_gcode(gcode) == (10.0, 20.0, 0.0, 30.0, 40.0, 5.0)\n",
    "tests/test_slicer.py": "import hashlib\nimport json\nimport zipfile\nfrom io import BytesIO\nfrom pathlib import Path\n\nimport pytest\n\nfrom autoeject.end_block import EjectBlockParams, build_end_block\nfrom autoeject.slicer import (\n    PLATE_GCODE_NAME,\n    PLATE_MD5_NAME,\n    SliceError,\n    inject_end_block,\n    md5_hex,\n    read_archive,\n    slice_stl,\n)\n\nFIXTURE = Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent / \"fixtures\" / \"real_a1.gcode.3mf\"\n\n\ndef plate_gcode(archive: bytes) -> str:\n    return read_archive(archive)[PLATE_GCODE_NAME].decode(\"utf-8\")\n\n\ndef assert_md5_matches(archive: bytes) -> None:\n    entries = read_archive(archive)\n    gcode = entries[PLATE_GCODE_NAME]\n    recorded = entries[PLATE_MD5_NAME].decode(\"ascii\").strip()\n    assert recorded == hashlib.md5(gcode).hexdigest().upper()\n    assert recorded == recorded.upper()\n\n\ndef test_fixture_md5_is_self_consistent():\n    assert_md5_matches(FIXTURE.read_bytes())\n\n\ndef test_inject_replaces_only_the_stock_end_block_span():\n    raw = FIXTURE.read_bytes()\n    template = build_end_block(\n        EjectBlockParams(\n            cool_bed_temp_c=22,\n            cool_hold_s=90,\n            heat_bed_temp_c=65,\n            heat_hold_s=45,\n            heat_cool_cycles=2,\n            push_feedrate_mm_min=450,\n        )\n    )\n    result = inject_end_block(raw, template)\n    gcode = plate_gcode(result)\n    original = plate_gcode(raw)\n\n    assert gcode.count(\"; MACHINE_END_GCODE_START\") == 1\n    assert gcode.count(\"; EXECUTABLE_BLOCK_END\") == 1\n    assert \"G1 Y-0.5 F450\" in gcode\n    assert gcode.count(\"M190 S22 ;\") == 2\n    assert gcode.count(\"M190 S65 ;\") == 2\n    assert gcode.count(\"G4 S90 ;\") == 2\n    assert gcode.count(\"G4 S45 ;\") == 2\n    assert \"G1 Z1 F600\" in gcode\n\n    # Everything outside the replaced span is byte-identical.\n    head, _, remainder = original.partition(\"; MACHINE_END_GCODE_START\")\n    _, _, tail = remainder.partition(\"; EXECUTABLE_BLOCK_END\")\n    new_head, _, new_remainder = gcode.partition(\"; MACHINE_END_GCODE_START\")\n    _, _, new_tail = new_remainder.partition(\"; EXECUTABLE_BLOCK_END\")\n    assert head == new_head\n    assert tail == new_tail\n\n    for line in gcode.splitlines():\n        if not line.lstrip().startswith(\";\"):\n            assert \"{\" not in line and \"}\" not in line\n    assert_md5_matches(result)\n\n\ndef test_inject_rejects_archive_without_unique_end_block():\n    raw = FIXTURE.read_bytes()\n    entries = read_archive(raw)\n    broken = entries[PLATE_GCODE_NAME].replace(b\"; MACHINE_END_GCODE_START\", b\"; nothing\")\n    buffer = BytesIO()\n    with zipfile.ZipFile(BytesIO(raw)) as source:\n        new_archive = source.namelist()\n    with zipfile.ZipFile(buffer, \"w\") as destination:\n        for name in new_archive:\n            destination.writestr(name, broken if name == PLATE_GCODE_NAME else entries[name])\n    with pytest.raises(ValueError):\n        inject_end_block(buffer.getvalue(), build_end_block())\n\n\nFAKE_CLI = \"\"\"#!/usr/bin/env python3\nimport hashlib\nimport json\nimport sys\nimport zipfile\n\nargs = sys.argv[1:]\n\n\ndef value(flag):\n    return args[args.index(flag) + 1]\n\n\nmachine = json.load(open(value(\"--load-settings\").split(\";\")[0]))\nblock = machine[\"machine_end_gcode\"]\npayload = (\n    \"; HEADER_BLOCK_START\\\\n\"\n    \"; max_z_height: 20.08\\\\n\"\n    \"; HEADER_BLOCK_END\\\\n\\\\n\"\n    \"; EXECUTABLE_BLOCK_START\\\\n\"\n    \"; MACHINE_END_GCODE_START\\\\n\"\n    + block\n    + \"\\\\n; EXECUTABLE_BLOCK_END\\\\n\"\n)\nencoded = payload.encode(\"utf-8\")\nwith zipfile.ZipFile(value(\"--export-3mf\"), \"w\") as archive:\n    archive.writestr(\"Metadata/plate_1.gcode\", encoded)\n    archive.writestr(\"Metadata/plate_1.gcode.md5\", hashlib.md5(encoded).hexdigest().upper())\nprint(\"fake sliced\")\n\"\"\"\n\n\nFAILING_CLI = \"\"\"#!/usr/bin/env python3\nimport sys\n\nprint(\"boom\", file=sys.stderr)\nsys.exit(3)\n\"\"\"\n\n\ndef _write_cli(tmp_path: Path, body: str) -> Path:\n    cli = tmp_path / \"fake_bambu\"\n    cli.write_text(body, encoding=\"utf-8\")\n    cli.chmod(0o755)\n    return cli\n\n\ndef _write_profiles(tmp_path: Path) -> Path:\n    root = tmp_path / \"profiles\"\n    (root / \"machine\").mkdir(parents=True)\n    (root / \"process\").mkdir()\n    (root / \"filament\").mkdir()\n    (root / \"machine\" / \"Bambu Lab A1 0.4 nozzle.json\").write_text(\n        json.dumps(\n            {\n                \"machine_end_gcode\": \"stock\",\n                \"default_print_profile\": \"0.20mm Standard @BBL A1\",\n                \"default_filament_profile\": [\"Bambu PLA Basic @BBL A1\"],\n            }\n        ),\n        encoding=\"utf-8\",\n    )\n    (root / \"process\" / \"0.20mm Standard @BBL A1.json\").write_text(\n        json.dumps({\"layer_height\": \"0.2\"}), encoding=\"utf-8\"\n    )\n    (root / \"filament\" / \"Bambu PLA Basic @BBL A1.json\").write_text(\n        json.dumps({\"filament_type\": \"PLA\"}), encoding=\"utf-8\"\n    )\n    return root\n\n\ndef test_slice_stl_patches_machine_end_gcode_through_the_cli(\n    tmp_path, monkeypatch\n):\n    cli = _write_cli(tmp_path, FAKE_CLI)\n    root = _write_profiles(tmp_path)\n    monkeypatch.setenv(\"BAMBU_CLI\", str(cli))\n    monkeypatch.setenv(\"BAMBU_PROFILE_ROOT\", str(root))\n\n    block = build_end_block(EjectBlockParams(push_feedrate_mm_min=450))\n    result = slice_stl(b\"synthetic stl bytes\", block)\n\n    gcode = plate_gcode(result)\n    assert \"G1 Y-0.5 F450\" in gcode\n    assert \"G1 Z{max_layer_z + 0.5} F900\" in gcode  # CLI evaluates in real use\n    assert_md5_matches(result)\n\n\ndef test_slice_stl_failure_directs_to_presliced_fallback(tmp_path, monkeypatch):\n    cli = _write_cli(tmp_path, FAILING_CLI)\n    root = _write_profiles(tmp_path)\n    monkeypatch.setenv(\"BAMBU_CLI\", str(cli))\n    monkeypatch.setenv(\"BAMBU_PROFILE_ROOT\", str(root))\n\n    with pytest.raises(SliceError) as error:\n        slice_stl(b\"synthetic stl bytes\", build_end_block())\n    assert \"pre-sliced\" in str(error.value)\n\n\ndef test_slice_stl_requires_bambu_cli(monkeypatch):\n    monkeypatch.delenv(\"BAMBU_CLI\", raising=False)\n    with pytest.raises(SliceError):\n        slice_stl(b\"synthetic stl bytes\", build_end_block())\n\n\ndef test_md5_hex_is_uppercase():\n    assert md5_hex(b\"abc\") == \"900150983CD24FB0D6963F7D28E17F72\"\n",

    "unified_diff": "--- /dev/null\n+++ b/Dockerfile\n@@ -0,0 +1,54 @@\n+# Auto-eject A1 web app image -- NOT built in CI.\n+#\n+# Building this image downloads a pinned BambuStudio CLI and is therefore kept\n+# out of automated test runs.  The CLI stage below is commented on purpose so a\n+# plain `docker build` cannot silently pull an unpinned slicer.\n+#\n+# To build locally: uncomment the BambuStudio block, verify the checksum/URL in\n+# the binding environment, then run `docker build -t autoeject .`.\n+\n+FROM python:3.13-slim AS runtime\n+\n+ENV PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 \\\n+    PYTHONUNBUFFERED=1 \\\n+    UV_LINK_MODE=copy \\\n+    UV_PROJECT_ENVIRONMENT=/opt/venv \\\n+    PATH=\"/opt/venv/bin:${PATH}\"\n+\n+# uv, pinned by digest so the runtime dependency resolution is reproducible.\n+COPY --from=ghcr.io/astral-sh/uv:0.5.11 /uv /uvx /bin/\n+\n+WORKDIR /app\n+\n+COPY pyproject.toml uv.lock ./\n+RUN uv sync --frozen --no-dev\n+\n+COPY autoeject ./autoeject\n+COPY app ./app\n+COPY profiles ./profiles\n+\n+# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n+# Pinned BambuStudio CLI (not run in CI).\n+#\n+# BambuStudio ships an AppImage; extract it into /opt/bambustudio and expose\n+# the CLI.  Pin the exact release used for the seed fixture and verify the\n+# checksum before use.\n+#\n+# ARG BAMBU_STUDIO_VERSION=02.04.00.70\n+# ARG BAMBU_STUDIO_URL=https://github.com/bambulab/BambuStudio/releases/download/v${BAMBU_STUDIO_VERSION}/Bambu_Studio_linux_ubuntu-v${BAMBU_STUDIO_VERSION}.AppImage\n+# RUN apt-get update \\\n+#     && apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends fuse libgl1 libglib2.0-0 \\\n+#     && rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/* \\\n+#     && curl -fsSL \"${BAMBU_STUDIO_URL}\" -o /opt/BambuStudio.AppImage \\\n+#     && chmod +x /opt/BambuStudio.AppImage \\\n+#     && /opt/BambuStudio.AppImage --appimage-extract \\\n+#     && mv squashfs-root /opt/bambustudio\n+ENV BAMBU_CLI=/opt/bambustudio/AppRun \\\n+    BAMBU_PROFILE_ROOT=/opt/bambustudio/resources/profiles/BBL\n+# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n+\n+EXPOSE 8000\n+\n+# The FastAPI app serves the static UI and the /api/check, /api/build and\n+# /api/simulate endpoints.\n+CMD [\"uvicorn\", \"app.main:app\", \"--host\", \"0.0.0.0\", \"--port\", \"8000\"]\n--- /dev/null\n+++ b/README.md\n@@ -0,0 +1,68 @@\n+# Auto-eject A1\n+\n+A web app for the **Bambu Lab A1 only** (256 \u00d7 256 mm bed). It turns one part into\n+a supervised loop of *N* prints, pushing each finished part off the bed with the\n+Factorian Designs end block.\n+\n+The Python core lives in `autoeject/` (no web imports); the FastAPI app and static\n+UI live in `app/`; tests live in `tests/`.\n+\n+## Endpoints\n+\n+| Method | Path | Purpose |\n+| --- | --- | --- |\n+| POST | `/api/check` | Measure an STL and return pass/warn/fail with reasons. |\n+| POST | `/api/build` | Slice an STL (or patch a sliced `.gcode.3mf`) and return an N-copy `.gcode.3mf`. |\n+| POST | `/api/simulate` | Replay the eject moves and report pushes, collisions and misses. |\n+\n+Multipart uploads use the field name `file`; the iteration count is the form\n+field `n`. Everything is synchronous and A1-only. A failing verdict blocks the\n+download; a warning is shown but does not block.\n+\n+> **Supervised use only.** The heat/cool cycle does not prove that the part has\n+> released. Inspect the bed and the exit path between copies; do not run the loop\n+> unattended.\n+\n+## Run locally\n+\n+Requires Python 3.13 and [uv](https://docs.astral.sh/uv/).\n+\n+```bash\n+uv sync\n+uv run uvicorn app.main:app --reload --port 8000\n+```\n+\n+Open <http://127.0.0.1:8000/> and upload an STL, or a pre-sliced `.gcode.3mf`.\n+Run the tests with:\n+\n+```bash\n+uv run pytest -q\n+```\n+\n+To slice in-process, point the app at a BambuStudio CLI and its installed A1\n+profiles:\n+\n+```bash\n+export BAMBU_CLI=/path/to/bambustudio/AppRun\n+export BAMBU_PROFILE_ROOT=/path/to/bambustudio/resources/profiles/BBL\n+```\n+\n+Without `BAMBU_CLI` the STL path returns a synchronous error and directs you to\n+the pre-sliced fallback.\n+\n+### Export a sliced plate from Bambu Studio\n+\n+1. Open the part in Bambu Studio, select the **Bambu Lab A1** printer and a\n+   process/filament profile, and slice it.\n+2. Use **File \u2192 Export \u2192 Export plate sliced file** (or the plate context menu\n+   **Export plate sliced file\u2026**) and save the `.gcode.3mf`.\n+3. Upload that file to the app. Only the stock end block, between\n+   `; MACHINE_END_GCODE_START` and `; EXECUTABLE_BLOCK_END`, is replaced; the\n+   `Metadata/plate_1.gcode.md5` companion is recomputed.\n+\n+## Deploy\n+\n+`railway.toml` builds the `Dockerfile` and starts\n+`uvicorn app.main:app --host 0.0.0.0 --port $PORT`. The Dockerfile leaves the\n+BambuStudio CLI install block commented out, so a plain image build does not\n+silently download an unpinned slicer.\n--- /dev/null\n+++ b/app/__init__.py\n@@ -0,0 +1 @@\n+\"\"\"FastAPI web app and static UI for the supervised A1 auto-eject workflow.\"\"\"\n--- /dev/null\n+++ b/app/main.py\n@@ -0,0 +1,253 @@\n+\"\"\"FastAPI surface for the supervised Bambu Lab A1 auto-eject workflow.\n+\n+The three endpoints mirror the binding v1 API list and are synchronous: every\n+request does its work inline and either returns the finished ``.gcode.3mf``\n+payload or a validation/slicing error.  There is no printer field, no printer\n+connection, no background job and no acknowledgement step.\n+\n+Both ``.gcode.3mf`` readers (this module and :mod:`autoeject.slicer`) are\n+exercised against ``fixtures/real_a1.gcode.3mf`` in ``tests/test_app.py``.\n+\"\"\"\n+\n+from __future__ import annotations\n+\n+import io\n+import json\n+from pathlib import Path\n+from typing import Any\n+\n+import trimesh\n+from fastapi import FastAPI, File, Form, HTTPException, UploadFile\n+from fastapi.responses import JSONResponse, Response\n+from fastapi.staticfiles import StaticFiles\n+\n+from autoeject.ejectability import check\n+from autoeject.end_block import EjectBlockParams, build_end_block\n+from autoeject.loop import loop_3mf\n+from autoeject.sim import (\n+    part_bbox_from_gcode,\n+    simulate,\n+)\n+from autoeject.slicer import (\n+    EXECUTABLE_BLOCK_END,\n+    MACHINE_END_START,\n+    SliceError,\n+    inject_end_block,\n+    read_plate_gcode,\n+    slice_stl,\n+)\n+\n+STATIC_DIR = Path(__file__).resolve().parent / \"static\"\n+DOWNLOAD_NAME = \"autoeject_a1.gcode.3mf\"\n+\n+app = FastAPI(\n+    title=\"Auto-eject A1\",\n+    version=\"1.0\",\n+    description=\"Supervised N-copy eject jobs for the Bambu Lab A1 (256 x 256 mm).\",\n+)\n+\n+\n+# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n+# Helpers\n+# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n+\n+\n+def _is_archive(filename: str | None, content: bytes) -> bool:\n+    \"\"\"A ``.gcode.3mf`` is a ZIP archive; sniff the magic first, name second.\"\"\"\n+    if content[:4] == b\"PK\\x03\\x04\":\n+        return True\n+    return (filename or \"\").lower().endswith(\".3mf\")\n+\n+\n+def _parse_bbox(raw: str | None) -> list[float] | None:\n+    if raw is None or not raw.strip():\n+        return None\n+    try:\n+        values = json.loads(raw)\n+    except ValueError:\n+        values = [item for item in raw.replace(\",\", \" \").split() if item]\n+    try:\n+        numbers = [float(value) for value in values]\n+    except (TypeError, ValueError) as exc:\n+        raise ValueError(\"bbox must be six numbers\") from exc\n+    if len(numbers) != 6:\n+        raise ValueError(\"bbox must be six numbers\")\n+    return numbers\n+\n+\n+def _first_end_block(gcode_text: str) -> str:\n+    \"\"\"Return the first eject span, tolerating an N-copy (repeated) archive.\"\"\"\n+    start = gcode_text.find(MACHINE_END_START)\n+    if start < 0:\n+        raise ValueError(f\"expected at least one {MACHINE_END_START!r} marker\")\n+    end = gcode_text.find(EXECUTABLE_BLOCK_END, start)\n+    if end < 0:\n+        raise ValueError(f\"expected {EXECUTABLE_BLOCK_END!r} after the end marker\")\n+    return gcode_text[start : end + len(EXECUTABLE_BLOCK_END)]\n+\n+\n+def _preview(stl_bytes: bytes) -> dict[str, Any]:\n+    mesh = trimesh.load(\n+        io.BytesIO(stl_bytes), file_type=\"stl\", force=\"mesh\", process=False\n+    )\n+    bounds = mesh.bounds\n+    return {\"bounds\": [float(value) for value in bounds.reshape(-1)]}\n+\n+\n+# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n+# Endpoints\n+# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n+\n+\n+@app.get(\"/api/health\")\n+async def health() -> dict[str, str]:\n+    return {\"status\": \"ok\"}\n+\n+\n+@app.post(\"/api/check\")\n+async def api_check(\n+    file: UploadFile = File(...),\n+    min_base_area_mm2: float | None = Form(None),\n+    max_tip_ratio: float | None = Form(None),\n+) -> dict[str, Any]:\n+    \"\"\"Measure an STL and return its verdict, reasons and preview box.\"\"\"\n+    content = await file.read()\n+    if _is_archive(file.filename, content):\n+        raise HTTPException(\n+            status_code=422,\n+            detail=(\n+                \"assessment needs an STL; upload the .gcode.3mf to /api/build \"\n+                \"and simulate it directly\"\n+            ),\n+        )\n+    try:\n+        report = check(\n+            content,\n+            min_base_area_mm2=min_base_area_mm2,\n+            max_tip_ratio=max_tip_ratio,\n+        )\n+        preview = _preview(content)\n+    except ValueError as exc:\n+        raise HTTPException(status_code=422, detail=str(exc)) from exc\n+    payload = report.to_dict()\n+    payload[\"measurements\"] = {\n+        rule[\"id\"]: rule[\"measured\"] for rule in payload[\"rules\"]\n+    }\n+    payload[\"preview\"] = preview\n+    return payload\n+\n+\n+@app.post(\"/api/build\")\n+async def _build(\n+    file: UploadFile = File(...),\n+    n: int = Form(1),\n+    cool_bed_temp_c: int = Form(25),\n+    cool_hold_s: int = Form(120),\n+    heat_bed_temp_c: int = Form(60),\n+    heat_hold_s: int = Form(60),\n+    heat_cool_cycles: int = Form(1),\n+    push_feedrate_mm_min: int = Form(600),\n+    min_base_area_mm2: float | None = Form(None),\n+    max_tip_ratio: float | None = Form(None),\n+) -> Response:\n+    \"\"\"Slice or patch an A1 job and repeat it N times, then download it.\"\"\"\n+    content = await file.read()\n+    try:\n+        eject_params = EjectBlockParams(\n+            cool_bed_temp_c=cool_bed_temp_c,\n+            cool_hold_s=cool_hold_s,\n+            heat_bed_temp_c=heat_bed_temp_c,\n+            heat_hold_s=heat_hold_s,\n+            heat_cool_cycles=heat_cool_cycles,\n+            push_feedrate_mm_min=push_feedrate_mm_min,\n+        )\n+        end_block = build_end_block(eject_params)\n+    except ValueError as exc:\n+        raise HTTPException(status_code=422, detail=str(exc)) from exc\n+\n+    warnings: list[dict[str, Any]] = []\n+    if _is_archive(file.filename, content):\n+        try:\n+            result = loop_3mf(inject_end_block(content, end_block), n)\n+        except (ValueError, SliceError) as exc:\n+            raise HTTPException(status_code=422, detail=str(exc)) from exc\n+    else:\n+        try:\n+            report = check(\n+                content,\n+                min_base_area_mm2=min_base_area_mm2,\n+                max_tip_ratio=max_tip_ratio,\n+            )\n+        except ValueError as exc:\n+            raise HTTPException(status_code=422, detail=str(exc)) from exc\n+        if report.verdict == \"fail\":\n+            # A failing verdict blocks the download synchronously.\n+            return JSONResponse(\n+                status_code=422,\n+                content={\n+                    \"error\": \"Part failed the ejectability assessment; build blocked.\",\n+                    \"verdict\": report.verdict,\n+                    \"reasons\": [\n+                        rule.reason\n+                        for rule in report.rules\n+                        if rule.verdict == \"fail\"\n+                    ],\n+                    \"rules\": [rule.to_dict() for rule in report.rules],\n+                },\n+            )\n+        warnings = [\n+            rule.to_dict() for rule in report.rules if rule.verdict == \"warn\"\n+        ]\n+        try:\n+            sliced = slice_stl(content, end_block)\n+            result = loop_3mf(sliced, n)\n+        except (ValueError, SliceError) as exc:\n+            raise HTTPException(status_code=422, detail=str(exc)) from exc\n+\n+    headers = {\n+        \"Content-Disposition\": f'attachment; filename=\"{DOWNLOAD_NAME}\"',\n+        \"X-Eject-Verdict\": \"warn\" if warnings else \"pass\",\n+    }\n+    return Response(\n+        content=result,\n+        media_type=\"application/octet-stream\",\n+        headers=headers,\n+    )\n+\n+\n+@app.post(\"/api/simulate\")\n+async def api_simulate(\n+    file: UploadFile = File(...),\n+    bbox: str | None = Form(None),\n+) -> dict[str, Any]:\n+    \"\"\"Replay eject moves from a plate G-code, end block or archive.\"\"\"\n+    content = await file.read()\n+    try:\n+        supplied = _parse_bbox(bbox)\n+        if _is_archive(file.filename, content):\n+            gcode = read_plate_gcode(content)\n+            block = _first_end_block(gcode)\n+            part = supplied if supplied is not None else part_bbox_from_gcode(gcode)\n+        else:\n+            try:\n+                text = content.decode(\"utf-8\")\n+            except UnicodeDecodeError as exc:\n+                raise ValueError(\"G-code must be UTF-8 text\") from exc\n+            block = (\n+                _first_end_block(text)\n+                if MACHINE_END_START in text\n+                else text\n+            )\n+            if supplied is None:\n+                raise ValueError(\n+                    \"a bounding box is required when simulating a bare end block\"\n+                )\n+
